WITH product_summary AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(quantity) AS quantity_count
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.cost,
    ps.total_quantity,
    ps.quantity_count
FROM products p
JOIN product_summary ps ON p.id = ps.product_id
WHERE ps.quantity_count > 4
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

product_summary = (
    df_inventory
    .groupBy("product_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("quantity").alias("total_quantity"),
        F.count("quantity").alias("quantity_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_products.alias("p")
    .join(product_summary.alias("ps"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("ps.product_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("ps.quantity_count") > 4)
    .select(
        F.col("p.id"),
        F.col("p.cost"),
        F.col("ps.total_quantity"),
        F.col("ps.quantity_count"),
    )
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(budget * 100, 2) AS budget_scaled,
        COALESCE(location, 'OTHER') AS resolved_location
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget <= 2370000
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND c.full_name IS NOT NULL
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        location,
        budget,
        budget_scaled,
        resolved_location,
        MAX(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name) AS location_max_budget,
        FIRST_VALUE(location) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY budget_scaled ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_location
    FROM kept
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN budget_scaled >= 83 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS budget_scaled_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Finance' THEN budget_scaled ELSE 0 END) AS finance_budget_scaled,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(location_max_budget, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS location_max_budget_quartiles
FROM enriched
GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget_scaled >= 83 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY event_count ASC NULLS FIRST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name")
w2 = Window.orderBy("budget_scaled", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("budget") <= 2370000)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("budget") * 100), 2).alias("budget_scaled"),
        F.coalesce("location", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_location"),
    )
)

kept = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.full_name").isNotNull()), "left_anti")
)

enriched = (
    kept
    .withColumn("location_max_budget", F.max("budget").over(w))
    .withColumn("first_known_location", F.first("location", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget_scaled") >= 83, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("budget_scaled_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "Finance", F.col("budget_scaled")).otherwise(0)).alias("finance_budget_scaled"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("location_max_budget", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("location_max_budget_quartiles"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("event_count").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits DESC, id) AS row_num
    FROM device_readings
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c DESC NULLS FIRST) AS temp_c_dense_rank,
        AVG(pressure) OVER w_running AS device_code_avg_pressure
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY device_code)
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) IS NULL
                 OR reading_ts > LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) + INTERVAL 20 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM metrics
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(temp_c * 1.07, 2) AS temp_c_scaled
    FROM sessionized
    WHERE reading_ts > TO_DATE('2025-09-01')
      AND device_code_avg_pressure < 1003
)
SELECT
    id,
    device_code,
    reading_ts,
    temp_c,
    humidity,
    pressure,
    status_bits,
    firmware,
    row_num
FROM filtered
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("status_bits").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc_nulls_first())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

deduped = (
    df_device_readings
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("temp_c_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("device_code_avg_pressure", F.avg("pressure").over(w_running))
)

with_gaps = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(w4).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(w4) + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w5))

filtered = (
    sessionized
    .filter((F.col("reading_ts") > F.to_date(F.lit("2025-09-01"))) & (F.col("device_code_avg_pressure") < 1003))
    .withColumn("temp_c_scaled", F.round((F.col("temp_c") * 1.07), 2))
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        "row_num",
    )
)

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(tier_limits) li AS val
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN plan = 'basic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_basic
    FROM flattened
    WHERE val BETWEEN 47 AND 54
),
valid_price_tiers AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        plan,
        val,
        is_basic,
        CEIL(is_basic) AS is_basic_whole,
        CEIL(val) AS val_whole
    FROM valid
    WHERE YEAR(effective_from) = 2023
)
SELECT
    plan,
    val,
    is_basic,
    is_basic_whole,
    val_whole
FROM valid_price_tiers
ORDER BY is_basic DESC NULLS FIRST, val

)

        SUM(sqft) OVER (ORDER BY opened_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sqft,

        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY region, city ORDER BY sqft ASC, id ASC) AS sqft_bucket
    FROM stores
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft ASC, id ASC)
)

with valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        upper(region) as region_upper,
        lower(store_name) as store_name_lower
    from stores
    where opened_date > date '2023-05-25'
      and region is not null
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by city, region order by opened_date desc, id) as row_seq,
        first_value(sqft, true) over (partition by city order by opened_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_sqft,
        max(sqft) over (partition by city) as city_max_sqft,
        max(sqft) over (partition by region) as region_max_sqft,
        first_value(sqft, true) over (partition by city order by sqft, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_sqft_2
    from valid
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        lead(row_seq, 1) over (partition by city order by first_known_sqft, id) as next_row_seq,
        first_value(sqft, true) over (order by region_max_sqft, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_sqft_3
    from metrics
),
deduped as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from scored
    qualify row_number() over (partition by city order by first_known_sqft desc nulls last, id) = 1
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
select *
from (
    select
        city,
        region,
        region_max_sqft
    from deduped
) src
pivot (
    sum(region_max_sqft)
    for region in ('East', 'West')
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("first_known_sqft", "id")
w7 = Window.orderBy("region_max_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("first_known_sqft").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

valid = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") > F.lit("2023-05-25").cast("date")) & F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "city",
        "region",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        F.upper("region").alias("region_upper"),
        F.lower("store_name").alias("store_name_lower"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("first_known_sqft", F.first("sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("city_max_sqft", F.max("sqft").over(w3))
    .withColumn("region_max_sqft", F.max("sqft").over(w4))
    .withColumn("first_known_sqft_2", F.first("sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w5))
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("row_seq", 1).over(w6).alias("next_row_seq"),
        F.first("sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w7).alias("first_known_sqft_3"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy("city")
    .pivot("region", ["East", "West"])
    .agg(F.sum("region_max_sqft"))
)

with cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        shipped_date,
        cost,
        status,
        upper(carrier) as carrier_upper
    from shipments
    where delivered_date > to_date('2024-01-10')
      and delivered_date > '2024-04-01'
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select status, id
    from cleaned
    except distinct
    select status, id
    from shipments
    where carrier = 'FedEx'
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from cleaned s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.status = k.status and s.id = k.id
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        date_add(shipped_date, 41) as shipped_date_plus_41d,
        last_day(shipped_date) as shipped_date_month_end
    from verified
    where status in ('RETURNED', 'LOST')
),
grouped as (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    select
        case when cost >= 97 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as cost_tier,
        count(*) as event_count,
        stddev_samp(cost) as cost_stddev,
        approx_percentile(cost, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as cost_quartiles,
        percentile_approx(cost, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as cost_quartiles_2,
        stddev_samp(cost) as cost_stddev_2,
        sum(case when status = 'LOST' then cost else 0 end) as lost_cost
    from filtered
    group by case when cost >= 97 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end
)
select
    cost_tier,
    cost_stddev,
    cost_quartiles,
    cost_quartiles_2,
    cost_stddev_2,
    lost_cost
from grouped
order by cost_tier desc nulls last
limit 20
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2024-01-10"))) & (F.col("delivered_date") > "2024-04-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.upper("carrier").alias("carrier_upper"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("status", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("carrier") == "FedEx")
        .select("status", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["RETURNED", "LOST"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_add("shipped_date", 41).alias("shipped_date_plus_41d"),
        F.last_day("shipped_date").alias("shipped_date_month_end"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    filtered
    .groupBy(F.when(F.col("cost") >= 97, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("cost_tier"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.stddev_samp("cost").alias("cost_stddev"),
        F.percentile_approx("cost", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("cost_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("cost", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("cost_quartiles_2"),
        F.stddev_samp("cost").alias("cost_stddev_2"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "LOST", F.col("cost")).otherwise(0)).alias("lost_cost"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "cost_tier",
        "cost_stddev",
        "cost_quartiles",
        "cost_quartiles_2",
        "cost_stddev_2",
        "lost_cost",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("cost_tier").desc_nulls_last())
    .limit(20)
)

with kept as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from sessions s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from web_events x
            where x.session_id = s.id
              and x.event_time <= s.started_at
        )
),
flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(started_at) over (partition by device order by started_at, id) is null
                 or started_at > lag(started_at) over (partition by device order by started_at, id) + interval '7' day then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from kept
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by device order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from flagged
),
with_last as (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select s.*, x.event_type
    from sessionized s
    join lateral (
            select c.event_type
            from web_events c
            where c.session_id = s.id
              and c.event_time <= s.started_at
            order by c.event_time desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(started_at) over (partition by browser order by started_at, id) is null
                 or started_at > lag(started_at) over (partition by browser order by started_at, id) + interval 14 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from with_last
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by browser order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from gaps
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select customer_id
    from islands
    except all
    select customer_id
    from sessions
    where browser in ('Firefox', 'Safari')
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from islands s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select browser
    from verified
    except all
    select browser
    from sessions
    where hour(started_at) between 9 and 12
),
verified_sessions as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from verified s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.browser = k.browser
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        e.*,
        d.segment,
        d.signup_date,
        d.city
    from verified_sessions e
    left join customers d
        on e.customer_id = d.id
),
summary as (
    -- Grouped metrics
    select
        case when session_start_flag >= 1 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as session_start_flag_tier,
        date_trunc('year', started_at) as year_start,
        event_type,
        count(*) as event_count,
        min(started_at) as first_started_at
    from with_dims
    group by case when session_start_flag >= 1 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end, date_trunc('year', started_at), event_type
    having count(*) > 1
)
select
    session_start_flag_tier,
    year_start,
    event_type,
    event_count,
    first_started_at
from summary

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.event_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

kept = (
    df_sessions
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("x"), (F.col("x.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.event_time") <= F.col("s.started_at")), "left_semi")
)

flagged = (
    kept
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

with_last = (
    sessionized
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.event_time") <= F.col("s.started_at")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.event_type"))
)

gaps = (
    with_last
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w4).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w4) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w5))

kept_keys = (
    islands
    .select("customer_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_sessions
        .filter(F.col("browser").isin(["Firefox", "Safari"]))
        .select("customer_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    islands
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

remaining_keys = (
    verified
    .select("browser")
    .exceptAll(
        df_sessions
        .filter(F.hour("started_at").between(9, 12))
        .select("browser")
    )
)

verified_sessions = (
    verified
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.browser") == F.col("k.browser")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_dims = (
    verified_sessions
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.segment"), F.col("d.signup_date"), F.col("d.city"))
)

summary = (
    with_dims
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("session_start_flag") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("session_start_flag_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("year", "started_at").alias("year_start"),
        "event_type",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.min("started_at").alias("first_started_at"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("event_count") > 1)
)

result = (

    .select(

        "year_start",
        "event_type",
        "event_count",
        "first_started_at",
    )
)

        host,
        attr_key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS attr_key, attr_value

        host,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        attr_key_prefix,
        CONCAT_WS('/', attr_key, host) AS attr_key_host_key
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL

filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        attr_key_prefix,
        attr_key_host_key,
        CASE WHEN attr_key = 'region' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_region,
        CASE WHEN attr_key IN ('region', 'trace') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS attr_key_group,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'DIRECT') AS attr_key_clean

    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL

valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows

        attr_value,

        CAST(is_region AS STRING) AS is_region_str_2,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'OTHER') AS resolved_attr_key
    FROM filtered

),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY is_region_str, id, attr_key) AS row_num
    FROM valid

),
ranked AS (

)

    attr_key,
    attr_value,
    attr_key_host_key,
    attr_key_group,

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS k, value
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        k,
        value,
        CASE WHEN status_code >= 412 THEN 'High' WHEN status_code >= 278 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS status_code_level,
        COALESCE(k, 'NONE') AS k_filled
    FROM lines
    WHERE host = 'h2'
),
valid_app_logs AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(k, 'Unknown') AS k_filled_2,
        COALESCE(k, 'OTHER') AS resolved_k
    FROM valid
    WHERE k NOT IN ('region', 'version')
)
SELECT
    id,
    k,
    value,
    status_code_level,
    k_filled,
    CASE WHEN k RLIKE '^(trace|region)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN k RLIKE '^(version)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'CORE' END AS k_zone
FROM valid_app_logs
ORDER BY k_zone NULLS FIRST

WITH scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        CORR(age, credit_limit) OVER w_grp corr_age_credit_limit,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY age NULLS LAST) age_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(segment, TRUE) OVER w_hist last_known_segment,
        LAG(credit_limit, 2) OVER w_hist_2 prev_credit_limit,
        AVG(age) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY credit_limit, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) age_avg_6_prior
    FROM customers
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY segment, city), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY credit_limit, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_hist_2 AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY signup_date, id)
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching account per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.account_opened_date
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.opened_date AS account_opened_date
            FROM accounts c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.opened_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM accounts ch
            WHERE ch.customer_id = s.id
              AND ch.opened_date <= s.signup_date
        )
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT country, segment
    FROM not_flagged
    EXCEPT
    SELECT country, segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date > '2024-05-01'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.country = k.country AND s.segment = k.segment
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    country,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN segment = 'Corporate' THEN 1 END) AS corporate_count,
    COUNT_IF(segment = 'Consumer') AS consumer_events,
    COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS distinct_countries,
    ROUND(SUM(age) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS age_per_bangkok
FROM verified
GROUP BY country
HAVING corporate_count >= 1
ORDER BY distinct_countries NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("segment", "city")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("age").asc_nulls_last())
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist_2 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("signup_date", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.opened_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

scored = (
    df_customers
    .select(
        "*",
        F.corr("age", "credit_limit").over(w_grp).alias("corr_age_credit_limit"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("age_cume_dist"),
        F.last("segment", ignorenulls=True).over(w_hist).alias("last_known_segment"),
        F.lag("credit_limit", 2).over(w_hist_2).alias("prev_credit_limit"),
        F.avg("age").over(w5).alias("age_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.opened_date").alias("account_opened_date"))
)

not_flagged = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.opened_date") <= F.col("s.signup_date")), "left_semi")
)

remaining_keys = (
    not_flagged
    .select("country", "segment")
    .subtract(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("signup_date") > "2024-05-01")
        .select("country", "segment")
    )
)

verified = (
    not_flagged
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.country") == F.col("k.country")) & (F.col("s.segment") == F.col("k.segment")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .groupBy("country")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Corporate", 1)).alias("corporate_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("segment") == "Consumer").alias("consumer_events"),
        F.countDistinct("country").alias("distinct_countries"),
        F.round(F.sum("age") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("age_per_bangkok"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("corporate_count") >= 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_countries").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', shipped_date) shipped_date_period,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), delivered_date) days_since_delivered_date,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'DIRECT') carrier_filled
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date > DATE '2023-03-09'
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(days_since_delivered_date) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier, status ORDER BY shipped_date_period, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) days_since_delivered_date_avg_5_prior,
        AVG(days_since_delivered_date) OVER (PARTITION BY status, carrier ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) days_since_delivered_date_avg_2,
        COUNT(days_since_delivered_date) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(shipped_date_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) days_since_delivered_date_count_30d,
        LEAD(cost, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY shipped_date_period, id) next_cost
    FROM filtered
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY days_since_delivered_date_avg_2 DESC, id) = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.status AS order_status,
        b.shipping_fee,
        b.discount
    FROM deduped e
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON e.order_id = b.id
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN shipped_date_period - LAG(shipped_date_period) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date_period, id) > INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM joined
),
sessions_shipments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date_period, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(shipped_date_period) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY shipped_date_period, id) AS prev_shipped_date_period
    FROM sessions_shipments
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_shipped_date_period IS NULL OR shipped_date_period > prev_shipped_date_period + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag_2
    FROM prev_events
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag_2) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY shipped_date_period, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_2
    FROM with_gaps
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        shipped_date_period,
        days_since_delivered_date,
        carrier_filled,
        days_since_delivered_date_avg_5_prior,
        days_since_delivered_date_avg_2,
        days_since_delivered_date_count_30d,
        next_cost,
        order_status,
        shipping_fee,
        discount,
        session_start_flag,
        burst_id,
        prev_shipped_date_period,
        session_start_flag_2,
        burst_id_2,
        AVG(days_since_delivered_date_avg_2) OVER (PARTITION BY order_status) order_status_avg_days_since_delivered_date_avg_2,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id), 4) cost_share
    FROM sessionized
)
SELECT
    id,
    carrier,
    delivered_date,
    cost,
    days_since_delivered_date_avg_5_prior,
    days_since_delivered_date_avg_2,
    days_since_delivered_date_count_30d,
    next_cost,
    order_status
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY cost NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "status").orderBy("shipped_date_period", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status", "carrier").orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("shipped_date_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipped_date_period", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("days_since_delivered_date_avg_2").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("shipped_date_period", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("shipped_date_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipped_date_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("order_status")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-03-09").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("shipped_date_period", F.date_trunc("month", "shipped_date"))
    .withColumn("days_since_delivered_date", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "delivered_date"))
    .withColumn("carrier_filled", F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("days_since_delivered_date").over(w).alias("days_since_delivered_date_avg_5_prior"),
        F.avg("days_since_delivered_date").over(w2).alias("days_since_delivered_date_avg_2"),
        F.count("days_since_delivered_date").over(w3).alias("days_since_delivered_date_count_30d"),
        F.lead("cost", 2, 0).over(w4).alias("next_cost"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

joined = (
    deduped
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("b.status").alias("order_status"),
        F.col("b.shipping_fee"),
        F.col("b.discount"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    joined
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("shipped_date_period") - F.lag("shipped_date_period").over(w6) > F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_shipments = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w7))

prev_events = (
    sessions_shipments
    .withColumn("prev_shipped_date_period", F.lag("shipped_date_period").over(w4))
)

with_gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("session_start_flag_2", F.when(F.col("prev_shipped_date_period").isNull() | (F.col("shipped_date_period") > F.col("prev_shipped_date_period") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("burst_id_2", F.sum("session_start_flag_2").over(w8))

with_windows = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("days_since_delivered_date_avg_2").over(w9).alias("order_status_avg_days_since_delivered_date_avg_2"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(w10)), 4).alias("cost_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "days_since_delivered_date_avg_5_prior",
        "days_since_delivered_date_avg_2",
        "days_since_delivered_date_count_30d",
        "next_cost",
        "order_status",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("cost").asc_nulls_last())

with lines as (
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        key,
        attr_value
    from app_logs
    lateral view explode(context) t as key, attr_value
),
enriched as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (order by log_ts desc, id, key) as row_seq,
        row_number() over (order by log_ts, id, key) as event_seq,
        last_value(key, true) over (partition by host order by log_ts, id, key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_key
    from lines
),
cleaned as (
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        key,
        event_seq,
        last_known_key,
        substring(service, 1, 3) as service_prefix
    from enriched
    where log_ts >= timestamp '2025-06-01 07:00:00'
      and key is not null
      and hour(log_ts) between 12 and 16
),
scored as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by key order by event_seq, id, key) as seq_no,
        round(event_seq / sum(event_seq) over (partition by key, service), 4) as event_seq_share
    from cleaned
),
with_gaps as (
    select *, case when lag(log_ts) over (partition by key order by log_ts, id, key) is null
                 or log_ts > lag(log_ts) over (partition by key order by log_ts, id, key) + interval '45' minute then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from scored
),
islands as (
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by key order by log_ts, id, key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from with_gaps
),
flagged as (
    select *, case when lag(log_ts) over (partition by host order by log_ts, id, key) is null
                 or log_ts > lag(log_ts) over (partition by host order by log_ts, id, key) + interval 20 minutes then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag_2
    from islands
),
sessions_app_logs as (
    select *, sum(session_start_flag_2) over (partition by host order by log_ts, id, key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id_2
    from flagged
),
latest as (
    select *, row_number() over (partition by service, key order by session_start_flag_2 desc nulls first, id, key) as rank_in_group
    from sessions_app_logs
    qualify rank_in_group = 1
)
select
    id,
    service,
    host,
    log_ts,
    key,
    event_seq,
    service_prefix,
    event_seq_share,
    burst_id
from latest
order by service, key
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").desc(), "id", "key")
w2 = Window.orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("event_seq", "id", "key")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("key", "service")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("service", "key").orderBy(F.col("session_start_flag_2").desc_nulls_first(), "id", "key")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        F.explode("context").alias("key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    lines
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
        F.last("key", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_key"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") >= F.lit("2025-06-01 07:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("key").isNotNull() & F.hour("log_ts").between(12, 16))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "event_seq",
        "last_known_key",
        F.substring("service", 1, 3).alias("service_prefix"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .withColumn("event_seq_share", F.round((F.col("event_seq") / F.sum("event_seq").over(w5)), 4))
)

with_gaps = (
    scored
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("log_ts").over(w6).isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.lag("log_ts").over(w6) + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w7))

flagged = (
    islands
    .withColumn("session_start_flag_2", F.when(F.lag("log_ts").over(w8).isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.lag("log_ts").over(w8) + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_app_logs = flagged.withColumn("burst_id_2", F.sum("session_start_flag_2").over(w3))

latest = (
    sessions_app_logs
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w9))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

result = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "event_seq",
        "service_prefix",
        "event_seq_share",
        "burst_id",
    )
    .orderBy("service", "key")
)

    select

        sum(units) over (partition by product_id order by revenue, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_units,

    from store_sales

        concat_ws(',', account_type, status) as account_type_status_key,
        coalesce(status, 'NONE') as status_clean
    from accounts
    where balance > 56000
),
not_flagged as (
    select s.*
    from base s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from transactions x
            where x.account_id = s.id
              and x.amount > 1600

cleaned as (

        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        status,
        account_type_status_key,
        status_clean,
        date_add(opened_date, 82) as opened_date_plus_82d,
        coalesce(status, 'N/A') as resolved_status
    from not_flagged
    where customer_id is not null
),
not_flagged_accounts as (
    select s.*
    from cleaned s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from transactions ch
            where ch.account_id = s.id
              and ch.is_flagged
        )
),
grouped as (
    select
        case when balance >= 88000 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as balance_tier,
        approx_percentile(balance, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as balance_quartiles,
        approx_percentile(balance, 0.9) as balance_p90,
        sum(balance) as total_balance,
        sort_array(collect_set(account_type)) as account_type_list,
        count_if(account_type = 'SAVINGS') as savings_events
    from not_flagged_accounts
    group by balance_tier
    having total_balance < 0
)
select
    balance_tier,
    balance_quartiles,
    balance_p90,
    total_balance,
    account_type_list,
    savings_events
from grouped
order by balance_p90 desc nulls first

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.col("balance") > 56000)
    .withColumn("account_type_status_key", F.concat_ws(",", "account_type", "status"))
    .withColumn("status_clean", F.coalesce("status", F.lit("NONE")))
)

not_flagged = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.amount") > 1600), "left_anti")
)

cleaned = (
    not_flagged
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "account_type",
        "balance",
        "status",
        "account_type_status_key",
        "status_clean",
        F.date_add("opened_date", 82).alias("opened_date_plus_82d"),
        F.coalesce("status", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_status"),
    )
)

not_flagged_accounts = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.is_flagged")), "left_anti")
)

        F.percentile_approx("balance", 0.9).alias("balance_p90"),
        F.sum("balance").alias("total_balance"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("account_type")).alias("account_type_list"),

        "balance_p90",
        "total_balance",

        "savings_events",

WITH flattened AS (

        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,

    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS k, value

SELECT
    CASE WHEN status_code >= 396 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS status_code_tier,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE service = 'auth') AS auth_rows,
    ROUND(AVG(status_code), 2) AS avg_status_code,
    MAX(log_ts) AS last_seen,
    ROUND(SUM(status_code) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN service = 'billing' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS status_code_per_billing,

with cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        trim(status) as clean_status
    from orders
    where channel is not null
),
kept as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from cleaned s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from payments c
            where c.order_id = s.id
              and c.paid_at >= s.order_date
        )
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        row_number() over w_hist as event_seq,
        sum(amount) over (order by shipping_fee, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_amount,
        corr(discount, amount) over (partition by channel, status) as corr_discount_amount,
        sum(shipping_fee) over (partition by store_id order by amount, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_shipping_fee
    from kept
    window w_hist as (partition by store_id order by amount desc, id)
),
kept_orders as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from enriched s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from shipments c
            where c.order_id = s.id
              and c.shipped_date <= s.order_date
        )
),
with_latest as (
    -- Latest matching shipment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select s.*, x.shipment_delivered_date
    from kept_orders s
    left join lateral (
            select c.delivered_date as shipment_delivered_date
            from shipments c
            where c.order_id = s.id
            order by c.cost desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    status,
    count(*) filter (where channel = 'mobile') as mobile_rows,
    count(distinct store_id) as distinct_store_ids,
    sum(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then event_seq else 0 end) as completed_event_seq
from with_latest

having mobile_rows < 1

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "status")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.cost").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.trim("status").alias("clean_status"),
    )
)

kept = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.paid_at") >= F.col("s.order_date")), "left_anti")
)

enriched = (
    kept
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w_hist).alias("event_seq"),
        F.sum("amount").over(w2).alias("running_amount"),
        F.corr("discount", "amount").over(w3).alias("corr_discount_amount"),
        F.sum("shipping_fee").over(w4).alias("running_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

kept_orders = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.shipped_date") <= F.col("s.order_date")), "left_anti")
)

with_latest = (
    kept_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.delivered_date").alias("shipment_delivered_date"))
)

result = (
    with_latest
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", 1)).alias("mobile_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("store_id").alias("distinct_store_ids"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED", F.col("event_seq")).otherwise(0)).alias("completed_event_seq"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("mobile_rows") < 1)
)

with metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        avg(rating) over (partition by city order by rating, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as rating_avg_2,
        row_number() over (order by rating desc, id) as event_seq,
        round(rating / sum(rating) over (partition by country), 4) as rating_share,
        ntile(10) over (partition by country, city order by rating desc, id) as rating_bucket,
        rank() over (partition by city order by rating nulls first) as rating_rank
    from suppliers
),
metrics_suppliers as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        rating_avg_2,
        event_seq,
        rating_share,
        rating_bucket,
        rating_rank,
        dense_rank() over (order by rating desc) as rating_dense_rank,
        cume_dist() over (partition by city order by rating desc nulls last) as rating_cume_dist
    from metrics
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.*,
        x.cost,
        x.launch_date
    from metrics_suppliers s
    left join lateral (
            select c.cost, c.launch_date
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
            order by c.launch_date desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id, city
    from latest_match
    except all
    select id, city
    from suppliers
    where rating < 2.5
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from latest_match s
    join remaining_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.city = k.city
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    city,
    case when rating_rank >= 8 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as rating_rank_tier,
    count(*) filter (where country = 'JP') as jp_rows,
    size(collect_set(country)) as num_countries,
    count(case when city = 'New York' then 1 end) as new_york_count,
    round(sum(rating_bucket) / nullif(count(case when country = 'SG' then 1 end), 0), 2) as rating_bucket_per_sg,
    percentile_approx(event_seq, 0.5) as event_seq_p50,
    count(*) filter (where city = 'Bangkok') as bangkok_rows
from kept_rows
group by city, rating_rank_tier
order by bangkok_rows
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").asc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("rating").desc())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.launch_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

metrics = (
    df_suppliers
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("rating").over(w).alias("rating_avg_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("rating") / F.sum("rating").over(w3)), 4).alias("rating_share"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w4).alias("rating_bucket"),
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("rating_rank"),
    )
)

metrics_suppliers = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w6).alias("rating_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w7).alias("rating_cume_dist"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    metrics_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.cost"), F.col("c.launch_date"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    latest_match
    .select("id", "city")
    .exceptAll(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("rating") < 2.5)
        .select("id", "city")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(
        "city",
        F.when(F.col("rating_rank") >= 8, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("rating_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("country") == "JP", 1)).alias("jp_rows"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("country")).alias("num_countries"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "New York", 1)).alias("new_york_count"),
        F.round(F.sum("rating_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("country") == "SG", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("rating_bucket_per_sg"),
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq", 0.5).alias("event_seq_p50"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", 1)).alias("bangkok_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy("bangkok_rows")
)

SELECT
    *,
    STDDEV_SAMP(amount) OVER w_part AS order_id_stddev_samp_amount,
    FIRST_VALUE(amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_amount,
    LAST_VALUE(amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY status, method ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_amount,
    SUM(amount) OVER w_recent AS amount_sum_7d
FROM payments
WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY order_id), w_recent AS (ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status", "method").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)

result = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("order_id_stddev_samp_amount", F.stddev_samp("amount").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("first_known_amount", F.first("amount", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("last_known_amount", F.last("amount", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
    .withColumn("amount_sum_7d", F.sum("amount").over(w_recent))
)

    CASE WHEN suppliers.rating >= 4.3 THEN 'high' WHEN suppliers.rating >= 1.8 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS rating_bucket,
    suppliers.country,
    MAX(store_sales.sale_date) AS latest_sale_date,
    ROUND(AVG(store_sales.units), 2) AS avg_units
FROM store_sales
LEFT JOIN products ON store_sales.product_id = products.id
LEFT JOIN suppliers ON products.supplier_id = suppliers.id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN suppliers.rating >= 4.3 THEN 'high' WHEN suppliers.rating >= 1.8 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, suppliers.country
ORDER BY avg_units DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_store_sales.alias("store_sales")
    .join(df_products.alias("products"), F.col("store_sales.product_id") == F.col("products.id"), "left")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("suppliers"), F.col("products.supplier_id") == F.col("suppliers.id"), "left")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("suppliers.rating") >= 4.3, "high").when(F.col("suppliers.rating") >= 1.8, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
        F.col("suppliers.country"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max(F.col("store_sales.sale_date")).alias("latest_sale_date"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.col("store_sales.units")), 2).alias("avg_units"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_units").desc())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', started_at) AS started_at_period
    FROM sessions
    WHERE browser NOT IN ('Firefox', 'Edge', 'Safari')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        browser,
        country,
        started_at_period,
        CONCAT(country, ' - ', device) AS country_device
    FROM filtered
    WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-03-25 06:00:00'
      AND browser IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, customer_id ORDER BY started_at_period DESC, id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    browser,
    country,
    country_device
FROM ranked
ORDER BY id DESC, browser ASC

    filtered

    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")

    .select("id", "browser", "country", "country_device")
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc(), "browser")

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        v
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) li as attr_key, v
),
cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        ceil(status_code) as status_code_whole
    from flattened
    where log_ts >= timestamp '2025-06-01 23:00:00'
      and attr_key is not null
      and attr_key <> 'trace'
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        max(status_code_whole) over (partition by service order by cast(log_ts as bigint) range between 900 preceding and current row) as status_code_whole_max_15m,
        max(latency_ms) over (partition by level) as level_max_latency_ms,
        cume_dist() over w_ordered as status_code_whole_cume_dist,
        round(latency_ms / sum(latency_ms) over (partition by attr_key), 4) as latency_ms_share
    from cleaned
    window w_ordered as (partition by attr_key order by status_code_whole desc nulls last)
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        status_code_whole,
        status_code_whole_max_15m,
        level_max_latency_ms,
        status_code_whole_cume_dist,
        latency_ms_share,
        percent_rank() over (partition by service order by status_code_whole) as status_code_whole_percent_rank,
        dense_rank() over (partition by level, attr_key order by status_code_whole_max_15m desc nulls last) as status_code_whole_max_15m_dense_rank,
        stddev_samp(status_code_whole) over (partition by level, service) as level_stddev_samp_status_code_whole
    from scored
),
grouped as (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    select
        date_trunc('hour', log_ts) as hour_window,
        count(*) filter (where service = 'search') as search_rows,
        sort_array(collect_set(service)) as service_list,
        bit_and(latency_ms) as latency_ms_bit_and
    from enriched
    group by hour_window
)
select
    hour_window,
    search_rows,
    service_list,
    latency_ms_bit_and
from grouped
order by search_rows desc nulls last

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("level")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("status_code_whole").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("status_code_whole")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("level", "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("status_code_whole_max_15m").desc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("level", "service")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    flattened
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") >= F.lit("2025-06-01 23:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("attr_key").isNotNull() & (F.col("attr_key") != "trace"))
    .select(
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        F.ceil("status_code").alias("status_code_whole"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("status_code_whole_max_15m", F.max("status_code_whole").over(w))
    .withColumn("level_max_latency_ms", F.max("latency_ms").over(w2))
    .withColumn("status_code_whole_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_share", F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(w4)), 4))
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .withColumn("status_code_whole_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w5))
    .withColumn("status_code_whole_max_15m_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w6))
    .withColumn("level_stddev_samp_status_code_whole", F.stddev_samp("status_code_whole").over(w7))
)

grouped = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("hour", "log_ts").alias("hour_window"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "search", 1)).alias("search_rows"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("service")).alias("service_list"),
        F.bit_and("latency_ms").alias("latency_ms_bit_and"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select("hour_window", "search_rows", "service_list", "latency_ms_bit_and")
    .orderBy(F.col("search_rows").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH lines AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS key, v
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY status_code DESC) AS status_code_rank,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host), 4) AS status_code_share,
        SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service, host ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_sum_1h,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY key, service), 4) AS status_code_share_2
    FROM lines
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN key IN ('trace', 'region') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS key_group,
        FLOOR(status_code_share_2) AS status_code_share_2_whole,
        COALESCE(key, 'OTHER') AS resolved_key
    FROM scored
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(status_code_sum_1h) OVER (PARTITION BY host) AS host_count_status_code_sum_1h,
        AVG(status_code_sum_1h) OVER w_running AS status_code_sum_1h_avg_15m,
        AVG(status_code_share) OVER w_recent AS status_code_share_avg_2h
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(status_code_share_2) OVER w_hist AS status_code_share_2_sum_30m,
        MAX(status_code_sum_1h) OVER (PARTITION BY host) AS host_max_status_code_sum_1h
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT host
    FROM with_windows
    INTERSECT
    SELECT host
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE host = 'h4'
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.host = k.host
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(status_code_share_avg_2h) OVER (PARTITION BY key) AS key_avg_status_code_share_avg_2h,
        AVG(status_code_share_2_sum_30m) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_share_2_sum_30m_avg_2h,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_part AS status_code_share_2_sum_30m_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_hist AS status_code_sum_1h_dense_rank
    FROM verified
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY status_code_share_2_sum_30m), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY status_code_sum_1h)
)
SELECT
    *,
    MIN(status_code_share_avg_2h) OVER (PARTITION BY host) AS host_min_status_code_share_avg_2h,
    SUM(key_avg_status_code_share_avg_2h) OVER (PARTITION BY service, host ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS key_avg_status_code_share_avg_2h_sum_15m
FROM metrics;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("host")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service", "host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("key", "service")
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("key")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w_part = Window.orderBy("status_code_share_2_sum_30m")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("status_code_sum_1h")
w12 = Window.partitionBy("service", "host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "v"),
    )
)

scored = (
    lines
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("status_code_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w2)), 4).alias("status_code_share"),
        F.sum("status_code").over(w3).alias("status_code_sum_1h"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w4)), 4).alias("status_code_share_2"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("key").isin(["trace", "region"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("key_group"),
        F.floor("status_code_share_2").alias("status_code_share_2_whole"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_key"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("status_code_sum_1h").over(w2).alias("host_count_status_code_sum_1h"),
        F.avg("status_code_sum_1h").over(w_running).alias("status_code_sum_1h_avg_15m"),
        F.avg("status_code_share").over(w_recent).alias("status_code_share_avg_2h"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("status_code_share_2").over(w_hist).alias("status_code_share_2_sum_30m"),
        F.max("status_code_sum_1h").over(w2).alias("host_max_status_code_sum_1h"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("host")
    .intersect(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("host") == "h4")
        .select("host")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.host") == F.col("k.host")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("status_code_share_avg_2h").over(w8).alias("key_avg_status_code_share_avg_2h"),
        F.avg("status_code_share_2_sum_30m").over(w9).alias("status_code_share_2_sum_30m_avg_2h"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_part).alias("status_code_share_2_sum_30m_dense_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w11).alias("status_code_sum_1h_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("status_code_share_avg_2h").over(w2).alias("host_min_status_code_share_avg_2h"),
        F.sum("key_avg_status_code_share_avg_2h").over(w12).alias("key_avg_status_code_share_avg_2h_sum_15m"),
    )
)

with filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        *,
        dayofweek(delivered_date) as delivered_date_dayofweek,
        substring(carrier, 1, 3) as carrier_prefix,
        coalesce(carrier, 'OTHER') as resolved_carrier
    from shipments
    where shipped_date > date '2023-03-09'
      and order_id is not null
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        delivered_date_dayofweek,
        carrier_prefix,
        resolved_carrier,
        first_value(delivered_date_dayofweek) ignore nulls over w_ordered as first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek,
        min(delivered_date_dayofweek) over (partition by order_id) as order_id_min_delivered_date_dayofweek
    from filtered
    window w_ordered as (order by delivered_date_dayofweek, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
filtered_shipments as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        date_format(shipped_date, 'yyyy-MM') as shipped_date_label,
        coalesce(carrier, 'N/A') as carrier_filled
    from scored
    where shipped_date > date '2023-08-01'
),
cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        carrier,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        delivered_date_dayofweek,
        carrier_prefix,
        resolved_carrier,
        first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek,
        shipped_date_label,
        carrier_filled,
        delivered_date_dayofweek * cost as delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost
    from filtered_shipments
    where cost < 48
),
scored_shipments as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        carrier,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        delivered_date_dayofweek,
        carrier_prefix,
        resolved_carrier,
        first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek,
        shipped_date_label,
        carrier_filled,
        delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost,
        row_number() over (partition by status order by delivered_date desc, id) as row_seq,
        ntile(5) over (partition by carrier order by delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost desc, id) as delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost_bucket,
        row_number() over w_running as event_seq,
        lag(first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek, 1) over (partition by status order by delivered_date_dayofweek, id) as prev_first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek
    from cleaned
    window w_running as (partition by carrier, status order by delivered_date_dayofweek, id)
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select carrier
    from scored_shipments
    except
    select carrier
    from shipments
    where shipped_date <= '2023-10-01'
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from scored_shipments s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.carrier = k.carrier
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        carrier,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        delivered_date_dayofweek,
        carrier_prefix,
        resolved_carrier,
        first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek,
        shipped_date_label,
        carrier_filled,
        delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost,
        row_seq,
        delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost_bucket,
        event_seq,
        prev_first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek,
        round(row_seq / sum(row_seq) over (partition by status), 4) as row_seq_share,
        rank() over (order by row_seq nulls last) as row_seq_rank,
        rank() over (partition by status, carrier order by row_seq desc nulls last) as row_seq_rank_2
    from verified
)
select
    id,
    carrier,
    delivered_date,
    cost,
    resolved_carrier,
    shipped_date_label,
    carrier_filled,
    row_seq,
    delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost_bucket
from enriched
order by cost, carrier

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.orderBy("delivered_date_dayofweek", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

w4 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost").desc(), "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "status").orderBy("delivered_date_dayofweek", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("delivered_date_dayofweek", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("row_seq").asc_nulls_last())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("status", "carrier").orderBy(F.col("row_seq").desc_nulls_last())

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-03-09").cast("date")) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("delivered_date_dayofweek", F.dayofweek("delivered_date"))
    .withColumn("carrier_prefix", F.substring("carrier", 1, 3))
    .withColumn("resolved_carrier", F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek", F.first("delivered_date_dayofweek", ignorenulls=True).over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("order_id_min_delivered_date_dayofweek", F.min("delivered_date_dayofweek").over(w2))
)

filtered_shipments = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-08-01").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("shipped_date_label", F.date_format("shipped_date", "yyyy-MM"))
    .withColumn("carrier_filled", F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("N/A")))
)

cleaned = (
    filtered_shipments
    .filter(F.col("cost") < 48)
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "delivered_date_dayofweek",
        "carrier_prefix",
        "resolved_carrier",
        "first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek",
        "shipped_date_label",
        "carrier_filled",
        (F.col("delivered_date_dayofweek") * F.col("cost")).alias("delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost"),
    )
)

scored_shipments = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .withColumn("delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w4))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_running))
    .withColumn("prev_first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek", F.lag("first_known_delivered_date_dayofweek", 1).over(w6))
)

remaining_keys = (
    scored_shipments
    .select("carrier")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("shipped_date") <= "2023-10-01")
        .select("carrier")
    )
)

verified = (
    scored_shipments
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("row_seq") / F.sum("row_seq").over(w7)), 4).alias("row_seq_share"),
        F.rank().over(w8).alias("row_seq_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w9).alias("row_seq_rank_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "resolved_carrier",
        "shipped_date_label",
        "carrier_filled",
        "row_seq",
        "delivered_date_dayofweek_times_cost_bucket",
    )
    .orderBy("cost", "carrier")
)
