WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating NULLS FIRST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM suppliers
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
deduped_suppliers AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rank_in_group DESC, id) AS rn
        FROM deduped
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped_suppliers s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND MONTH(c.launch_date) IN (1, 5, 8)
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        rank_in_group,
        rn,
        LAST_VALUE(rating, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_rating,
        ROUND(rating / SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city), 4) AS rating_share,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY rating NULLS LAST) AS rating_cume_dist,
        FIRST_VALUE(city, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_city
    FROM kept
),
with_windows_suppliers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        LEAD(rating_share, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rn, id) AS next_rating_share,
        FIRST_VALUE(rating_cume_dist, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_rating_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        rank_in_group,
        rn,
        last_known_rating,
        rating_share,
        rating_cume_dist,
        first_known_city,
        event_seq,
        next_rating_share,
        first_known_rating_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY first_known_rating_cume_dist, id) AS event_seq_2,
        SUM(rating_share) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY first_known_rating_cume_dist, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_rating_share
    FROM with_windows_suppliers
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(rating_cume_dist, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_rating_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY first_known_rating_cume_dist NULLS LAST) AS first_known_rating_cume_dist_dense_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY event_seq DESC, id) AS row_seq
    FROM scored
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        CASE WHEN rating_share >= 0.69 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS rating_share_tier,
        CASE WHEN rating_cume_dist >= 0.8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS rating_cume_dist_tier,
        MIN(cumulative_rating_share) AS min_cumulative_rating_share,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Berlin') AS berlin_rows,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        AVG(first_known_rating_cume_dist) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Tokyo') AS tokyo_avg_first_known_rating_cume_dist,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows
    FROM enriched
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING min_cumulative_rating_share < 0
)
SELECT
    country,
    rating_share_tier,
    rating_cume_dist_tier,
    min_cumulative_rating_share,
    cnt,
    tokyo_avg_first_known_rating_cume_dist,
    num_rows
FROM daily
ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("rank_in_group").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("rating").asc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rn", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rn", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("first_known_rating_cume_dist", "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("first_known_rating_cume_dist", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w13 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy(F.col("first_known_rating_cume_dist").asc_nulls_last())
w14 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc(), "id")

deduped = (
    df_suppliers
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

deduped_suppliers = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

kept = (
    deduped_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.month(F.col("c.launch_date")).isin([1, 5, 8])), "left_semi")
)

with_windows = (
    kept
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("rating", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_rating"),
        F.round((F.col("rating") / F.sum("rating").over(w4)), 4).alias("rating_share"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("rating_cume_dist"),
        F.first("city", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("first_known_city"),
    )
)

with_windows_suppliers = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("event_seq"),
        F.lead("rating_share", 1).over(w8).alias("next_rating_share"),
        F.first("rating_cume_dist", ignorenulls=True).over(w9).alias("first_known_rating_cume_dist"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows_suppliers
    .withColumn("event_seq_2", F.row_number().over(w10))
    .withColumn("cumulative_rating_share", F.sum("rating_share").over(w11))
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("rating_cume_dist", ignorenulls=True).over(w12).alias("last_known_rating_cume_dist"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w13).alias("first_known_rating_cume_dist_dense_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(w14).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

daily = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        "country",
        F.when(F.col("rating_share") >= 0.69, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("rating_share_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("rating_cume_dist") >= 0.8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("rating_cume_dist_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("cumulative_rating_share").alias("min_cumulative_rating_share"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Berlin", 1)).alias("berlin_rows"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("city") == "Tokyo", F.col("first_known_rating_cume_dist"))).alias("tokyo_avg_first_known_rating_cume_dist"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_cumulative_rating_share") < 0)
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "country",
        "rating_share_tier",
        "rating_cume_dist_tier",
        "min_cumulative_rating_share",
        "cnt",
        "tokyo_avg_first_known_rating_cume_dist",
        "num_rows",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("cnt").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        quantity - unit_price AS line_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND unit_price IS NOT NULL
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT product_id, order_id
    FROM valid
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT product_id, order_id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.order_id = k.order_id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        CORR(quantity, unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS corr_quantity_unit_price,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY quantity DESC NULLS LAST) AS quantity_rank
    FROM verified
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_total,
    corr_quantity_unit_price,
    quantity_rank
FROM scored
ORDER BY quantity_rank DESC, corr_quantity_unit_price;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc_nulls_last())

valid = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull() & F.col("unit_price").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        (F.col("quantity") - F.col("unit_price")).alias("line_total"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    valid
    .select("product_id", "order_id")
    .subtract(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
        .select("product_id", "order_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    verified
    .withColumn("corr_quantity_unit_price", F.corr("quantity", "unit_price").over(w))
    .withColumn("quantity_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        "line_total",
        "corr_quantity_unit_price",
        "quantity_rank",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quantity_rank").desc(), "corr_quantity_unit_price")
)

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        coupon_codes,
        line.product_id,
        line.qty,
        line.price
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(items) t AS line
),
lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        qty,
        EXPLODE(coupon_codes) AS code
    FROM exploded
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY qty DESC) AS qty_percent_rank,
        AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS customer_id_avg_qty
    FROM lines
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN qty_percent_rank >= 0.76 THEN 'High' WHEN qty_percent_rank >= 0.37 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS qty_percent_rank_band
    FROM enriched
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', created_at) AS hour_window,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customer_ids,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(code)) AS code_list,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE code = 'VIP') AS vip_rows
FROM filtered
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY vip_rows DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")

exploded = (
    df_carts
    .withColumn("line", F.explode("items"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "created_at",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.col("line.product_id"),
        F.col("line.qty"),
        F.col("line.price"),
    )
)

lines = (
    exploded
    .select("customer_id", "created_at", "qty", F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("code"))
)

enriched = (
    lines
    .withColumn("qty_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("customer_id_avg_qty", F.avg("qty").over(w2))
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("qty_percent_rank_band", F.when(F.col("qty_percent_rank") >= 0.76, "High").when(F.col("qty_percent_rank") >= 0.37, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("HOUR", "created_at").alias("hour_window"))
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("customer_id").alias("distinct_customer_ids"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("code")).alias("code_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("code") == "VIP", 1)).alias("vip_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("vip_rows").desc())
)

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        CASE WHEN region = 'East' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_east
    FROM stores
    WHERE region IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (

    FROM valid s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales x
            WHERE x.store_id = s.id
              AND x.sale_date <= s.opened_date
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        is_east,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqft DESC) AS sqft_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS event_seq,
        SUM(sqft) OVER w_grp AS cumulative_sqft
    FROM kept
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY sqft DESC, id), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY is_east, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_windows_stores AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        is_east,
        sqft_rank,
        event_seq,
        cumulative_sqft,
        AVG(event_seq) OVER w_running AS event_seq_avg_5_prior,
        SUM(event_seq) OVER w_ordered AS region_sum_event_seq,
        LAG(is_east, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft, id) AS prev_is_east
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY region)
)
SELECT
    region,
    MAX(sqft) FILTER (WHERE region = 'North') AS north_max_sqft,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE region = 'North') AS north_rows
FROM with_windows_stores
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY north_max_sqft;

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("is_east", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("region")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft", "id")

valid = (

    .select(

        "store_name",
        "region",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",

    .join(df_store_sales.alias("x"), (F.col("x.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.sale_date") <= F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_anti")

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        TRIM(status) clean_status
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE end_date >= TO_DATE('2024-03-14')
),
attributed AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM base src
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON src.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND src.start_date BETWEEN sub.start_date AND sub.end_date
),
base_subscriptions AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        clean_status,
        subscription_id,
        subscription_monthly_fee,
        UPPER(plan) plan_upper,
        ADD_MONTHS(start_date, 3) start_date_plus_months
    FROM attributed
    WHERE start_date > DATE '2024-01-31'
      AND subscription_plan IS NOT NULL
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        status,
        subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM base_subscriptions
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(subscription_monthly_fee)
    FOR status IN ('EXPIRED', 'PAUSED', 'CANCELLED')
)
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("end_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2024-03-14")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.trim("status").alias("clean_status"),
    )
)

attributed = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & F.col("src.start_date").between(F.col("sub.start_date"), F.col("sub.end_date")), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

base_subscriptions = (
    attributed
    .filter((F.col("start_date") > F.lit("2024-01-31").cast("date")) & F.col("subscription_plan").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        "clean_status",
        "subscription_id",
        "subscription_monthly_fee",
        F.upper("plan").alias("plan_upper"),
        F.add_months("start_date", 3).alias("start_date_plus_months"),
    )
)

result = (
    base_subscriptions
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .pivot("status", ["EXPIRED", "PAUSED", "CANCELLED"])
    .agg(F.avg("subscription_monthly_fee"))
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(discounts) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(tier_value, 2) AS tier_value_rounded,
        TRIM(plan) AS clean_plan
    FROM lines
    WHERE plan = 'pro'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value,
        tier_value_rounded,
        clean_plan,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_hist AS tier_value_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_ordered AS tier_value_rounded_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS LAST), w_ordered AS (ORDER BY tier_value_rounded DESC NULLS LAST)
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT plan, currency
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT
    SELECT plan, currency
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE currency IN ('EUR', 'USD', 'THB')
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.plan = k.plan AND s.currency = k.currency
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value,
        tier_value_rounded,
        tier_value_percent_rank,
        tier_value_rounded_percent_rank,
        tier_value_dense_rank,
        CASE WHEN tier_value >= 67 THEN 'High' WHEN tier_value >= 14 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS tier_value_tier
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE currency IN ('EUR', 'USD', 'THB')
),
cleaned_price_tiers AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN tier_value_rounded >= 90 THEN 'High' WHEN tier_value_rounded >= 38 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS tier_value_rounded_level
    FROM filtered
    WHERE plan = 'pro'
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value,
        tier_value_rounded,
        tier_value_percent_rank,
        tier_value_rounded_percent_rank,
        tier_value_dense_rank,
        tier_value_tier,
        tier_value_rounded_level,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value_rounded DESC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_rounded_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(tier_value_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_rounded,
        MAX(tier_value_rounded_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY plan, currency) AS plan_max_tier_value_rounded_percent_rank,
        MAX(tier_value_rounded_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY currency, plan) AS currency_max_tier_value_rounded_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value_rounded) AS tier_value_rounded_cume_dist
    FROM cleaned_price_tiers
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
SELECT
    *,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency, plan ORDER BY tier_value_rounded_rank NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_rounded_rank_cume_dist,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value_rounded_cume_dist NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_rounded_cume_dist_percent_rank,
    COUNT(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY currency, plan) AS currency_count_tier_value
FROM scored

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_last())
w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_rounded").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("plan", "currency")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("currency", "plan")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("tier_value_rounded")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("currency", "plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value_rounded_rank").asc_nulls_last())
w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_rounded_cume_dist").asc_nulls_last())

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode("discounts").alias("tier_value"))
)

cleaned = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("plan") == "pro")
    .withColumn("tier_value_rounded", F.round("tier_value", 2))
    .withColumn("clean_plan", F.trim("plan"))
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("tier_value_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("tier_value_rounded_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("tier_value_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w3))
)

matched_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("plan", "currency")
    .subtract(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("currency").isin(["EUR", "USD", "THB"]))
        .select("plan", "currency")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.plan") == F.col("k.plan")) & (F.col("s.currency") == F.col("k.currency")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("currency").isin(["EUR", "USD", "THB"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency",
        "tier_value",
        "tier_value_rounded",
        "tier_value_percent_rank",
        "tier_value_rounded_percent_rank",
        "tier_value_dense_rank",
        F.when(F.col("tier_value") >= 67, "High").when(F.col("tier_value") >= 14, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("tier_value_tier"),
    )
)

cleaned_price_tiers = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("plan") == "pro")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("tier_value_rounded") >= 90, "High").when(F.col("tier_value_rounded") >= 38, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("tier_value_rounded_level"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned_price_tiers
    .withColumn("tier_value_rounded_rank", F.rank().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_rounded", F.stddev_samp("tier_value_rounded").over(w4))
    .withColumn("plan_max_tier_value_rounded_percent_rank", F.max("tier_value_rounded_percent_rank").over(w5))
    .withColumn("currency_max_tier_value_rounded_percent_rank", F.max("tier_value_rounded_percent_rank").over(w6))
    .withColumn("tier_value_rounded_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w7))
)

result = (
    scored
    .withColumn("tier_value_rounded_rank_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w8))
    .withColumn("tier_value_rounded_cume_dist_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w9))
    .withColumn("currency_count_tier_value", F.count("tier_value").over(w6))
)

with cleaned as (
    select *, coalesce(city, 'N/A') as city_filled
    from suppliers
    where city not in ('Berlin', 'Tokyo', 'London')
),
not_flagged as (
    select s.*
    from cleaned s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
              and c.stock_qty between 124 and 211
        )
),
scored as (
    select
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        city_filled,
        percent_rank() over (partition by city order by rating nulls last) as rating_percent_rank,
        ntile(10) over w_grp as rating_bucket
    from not_flagged
    window w_grp as (partition by country order by rating, id)
),
enriched as (
    select
        *,
        cume_dist() over (partition by city order by rating_bucket desc nulls first) as rating_bucket_cume_dist,
        row_number() over (partition by city order by rating_percent_rank, id) as event_seq,
        last_value(rating_percent_rank) ignore nulls over (partition by country order by rating_percent_rank, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_rating_percent_rank
    from scored
),
with_windows as (
    select
        *,
        ntile(4) over (partition by city order by rating, id) as rating_bucket_2,
        percent_rank() over w_grp as rating_percent_rank_2,
        percent_rank() over (partition by city, country order by last_known_rating_percent_rank nulls first) as last_known_rating_percent_rank_percent_rank,
        sum(rating_bucket_cume_dist) over w_ordered as cumulative_rating_bucket_cume_dist
    from enriched
    window w_grp as (partition by city order by rating desc nulls last), w_ordered as (partition by city order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
latest as (
    select *
    from with_windows
    qualify row_number() over (partition by city, country order by last_known_rating_percent_rank_percent_rank, id) = 1
)
select
    case when rating_bucket_2 >= 8 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as rating_bucket_2_tier,
    case when event_seq >= 9 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as event_seq_tier,
    case when cumulative_rating_bucket_cume_dist >= 4 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as cumulative_rating_bucket_cume_dist_tier,
    count(*) filter (where city = 'New York') as new_york_rows,
    max(rating_bucket_cume_dist) as max_rating_bucket_cume_dist,
    min(rating_bucket_cume_dist) as min_rating_bucket_cume_dist,
    rank() over (partition by case when rating_bucket_2 >= 8 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end order by min(rating_bucket_cume_dist) desc) as min_rating_bucket_cume_dist_rank
from latest
group by rating_bucket_2_tier, event_seq_tier, cumulative_rating_bucket_cume_dist_tier
order by cumulative_rating_bucket_cume_dist_tier desc;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").asc_nulls_last())
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating_bucket").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating_percent_rank", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating_percent_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy(F.col("last_known_rating_percent_rank").asc_nulls_first())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy("last_known_rating_percent_rank_percent_rank", "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("rating_bucket_2_tier").orderBy(F.col("min_rating_bucket_cume_dist").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(~F.col("city").isin(["Berlin", "Tokyo", "London"]))
    .select("*", F.coalesce("city", F.lit("N/A")).alias("city_filled"))
)

not_flagged = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.stock_qty").between(124, 211)), "left_anti")
)

scored = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w).alias("rating_percent_rank"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w_grp).alias("rating_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("rating_bucket_cume_dist"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("event_seq"),
        F.last("rating_percent_rank", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("last_known_rating_percent_rank"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(4).over(w6).alias("rating_bucket_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("rating_percent_rank_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w8).alias("last_known_rating_percent_rank_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("rating_bucket_cume_dist").over(w_ordered).alias("cumulative_rating_bucket_cume_dist"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w10))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

result = (
    latest
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("rating_bucket_2") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("rating_bucket_2_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("event_seq") >= 9, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("event_seq_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("cumulative_rating_bucket_cume_dist") >= 4, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("cumulative_rating_bucket_cume_dist_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "New York", 1)).alias("new_york_rows"),
        F.max("rating_bucket_cume_dist").alias("max_rating_bucket_cume_dist"),
        F.min("rating_bucket_cume_dist").alias("min_rating_bucket_cume_dist"),
    )
    .withColumn("min_rating_bucket_cume_dist_rank", F.rank().over(w11))
    .orderBy(F.col("cumulative_rating_bucket_cume_dist_tier").desc())
)

    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
base AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'unassigned') AS attr_key_filled_2,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_attr_key
    FROM verified
    WHERE attr_key NOT IN ('weight_kg', 'device')
)

    id,
    created_at,
    attr_key,
    attr_key_filled,
    attr_key_group,
    attr_key_filled_2,
    resolved_attr_key
FROM base;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

exploded = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        F.explode_outer("attributes").alias("attr_key", "value"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    exploded
    .filter((F.col("created_at") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2025-03-02"))) & F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("attr_key_filled", F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("N/A")))
    .withColumn("attr_key_group", F.when(F.col("attr_key").isin(["weight_kg", "utm_source"]), "Core").otherwise("Other"))
)

remaining_keys = (

    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.to_date("created_at") < "2025-01-01")
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    verified
    .filter(~F.col("attr_key").isin(["weight_kg", "device"]))
    .select(

        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("attr_key_filled_2"),

    )
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        INITCAP(TRIM(country)) AS country_title
    FROM sessions
    WHERE browser <> 'Safari'
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY started_at, id) AS row_seq_2
    FROM valid
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        country_title,
        row_seq,
        row_seq_2,
        COUNT(row_seq_2) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, browser ORDER BY CAST(started_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS row_seq_2_count_7d,
        SUM(row_seq_2) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY row_seq_2, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_row_seq_2,
        LEAD(row_seq, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY row_seq, id) AS next_row_seq
    FROM scored
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time >= s.started_at
        )
),
stats AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', started_at) AS year_start,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(browser)) AS num_browsers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT browser) AS distinct_browsers,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(row_seq_2_count_7d, 0.9) AS row_seq_2_count_7d_p90,
        COUNT_IF(browser = 'Chrome') AS chrome_events,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(browser)) AS browser_list
    FROM not_flagged
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', started_at)
)
SELECT
    year_start,
    num_browsers,
    distinct_browsers,
    row_seq_2_count_7d_p90,
    chrome_events,
    browser_list
FROM stats
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("started_at", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "browser").orderBy(F.col("started_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("row_seq_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("row_seq", "id")

valid = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("browser") != "Safari")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.initcap(F.trim("country")).alias("country_title"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq_2"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_seq_2_count_7d", F.count("row_seq_2").over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_row_seq_2", F.sum("row_seq_2").over(w4))
    .withColumn("next_row_seq", F.lead("row_seq", 1, 0).over(w5))
)

not_flagged = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.event_time") >= F.col("s.started_at")), "left_anti")
)

stats = (
    not_flagged
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "started_at").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("browser")).alias("num_browsers"),
        F.countDistinct("browser").alias("distinct_browsers"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("country")).alias("country_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("row_seq_2_count_7d", 0.9).alias("row_seq_2_count_7d_p90"),
        F.count_if(F.col("browser") == "Chrome").alias("chrome_events"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("browser")).alias("browser_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "year_start",
        "num_browsers",
        "distinct_browsers",
        "row_seq_2_count_7d_p90",
        "chrome_events",
        "browser_list",
    )
)

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, INITCAP(TRIM(status)) AS status_title
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE start_date > DATE '2023-12-30'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND end_date <= '2025-08-01'
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT customer_id, id
    FROM filtered
    INTERSECT
    SELECT customer_id, id
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE start_date >= '2023-05-12'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id AND s.id = k.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(monthly_fee / SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status), 4) AS monthly_fee_share,
        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_avg_monthly_fee,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, plan) AS customer_id_sum_monthly_fee
    FROM verified
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    plan,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    monthly_fee,
    status,
    status_title,
    monthly_fee_share,
    status_avg_monthly_fee,
    customer_id_sum_monthly_fee,
    COUNT(monthly_fee_share) OVER w_grp AS customer_id_count_monthly_fee_share,
    STDDEV_SAMP(customer_id_sum_monthly_fee) OVER w_recent AS plan_stddev_samp_customer_id_sum_monthly_fee,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER w_ordered AS monthly_fee_share_dense_rank
FROM metrics
WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY customer_id), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY plan), w_ordered AS (ORDER BY monthly_fee_share DESC);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "plan")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_share").desc())

filtered = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("start_date") > F.lit("2023-12-30").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("end_date") <= "2025-08-01"))
    .withColumn("status_title", F.initcap(F.trim("status")))
)

kept_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("customer_id", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_subscriptions
        .filter(F.col("start_date") >= "2023-05-12")
        .select("customer_id", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    verified
    .withColumn("monthly_fee_share", F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") / F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w)), 4))
    .withColumn("status_avg_monthly_fee", F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w))
    .withColumn("customer_id_sum_monthly_fee", F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w2))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("monthly_fee_share").over(w_grp).alias("customer_id_count_monthly_fee_share"),
        F.stddev_samp("customer_id_sum_monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("plan_stddev_samp_customer_id_sum_monthly_fee"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_ordered).alias("monthly_fee_share_dense_rank"),
    )
)

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_restock) AS last_restock_period
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= TO_DATE('2023-11-07')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock_period DESC, id) AS rn
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY quantity NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
latest_inventory AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rn DESC, id) = 1
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.store_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.quantity,
    s.last_restock_period,
    s.rn,
    s.latest_rank,
    (SELECT MIN(x.shipping_fee) FROM orders x WHERE x.store_id = s.store_id) AS min_order_shipping_fee
FROM latest_inventory s
ORDER BY min_order_shipping_fee, store_id;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock_period").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("rn").desc(), "id")
shipping_fee_by_store_id = df_orders.groupBy("store_id").agg(F.min("shipping_fee").alias("min_order_shipping_fee"))

valid = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-11-07")))
    .select("*", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "last_restock").alias("last_restock_period"))
)

ranked = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

latest = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

latest_inventory = (
    latest
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

result = (
    latest_inventory
    .join(shipping_fee_by_store_id, on="store_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock_period",
        "rn",
        "latest_rank",
        F.col("min_order_shipping_fee"),
    )
    .orderBy("min_order_shipping_fee", "store_id")
)

sql: with gaps as (select *, case when reading_ts - lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id) > interval 1 hour then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst from device_readings), sessionized as (select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id from gaps) select device_code, round(avg(status_bits), 2) as avg_status_bits, max(reading_ts) as last_reading_ts, count(distinct firmware) as distinct_firmwares, stddev_samp(temp_c) as temp_c_stddev, stddev_samp(status_bits) as status_bits_stddev from sessionized group by 1;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")

sql: WITH flattened_attrs AS (SELECT id, service, host, log_ts, level, status_code, FROM_JSON(payload_json, 'STRUCT<user: STRUCT<id: INT, tier: STRING>, duration: DOUBLE, retries: INT, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>').duration AS duration_sec, ARRAY_CONTAINS(MAP_KEYS(context), 'version') AS has_version, COALESCE(context['version'], 'direct') AS version_or_default, GET_JSON_OBJECT(payload_json, '$.duration') AS duration_text FROM app_logs) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts) AS activity_day, CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 3.4 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS duration_sec_tier, COUNT(*) AS row_count, ROUND(AVG(duration_sec), 2) AS avg_duration_sec, ROUND(SUM(status_code) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN service = 'auth' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS status_code_per_auth FROM flattened_attrs GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY row_count
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

flattened_attrs = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.from_json("payload_json", "STRUCT<user: STRUCT<id: INT, tier: STRING>, duration: DOUBLE, retries: INT, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>")["duration"].alias("duration_sec"),
        F.array_contains(F.map_keys("context"), "version").alias("has_version"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("context").getItem("version"), F.lit("direct")).alias("version_or_default"),
        F.get_json_object("payload_json", "$.duration").alias("duration_text"),
    )
)

result = (
    flattened_attrs
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("DAY", "log_ts").alias("activity_day"),
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 3.4, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("duration_sec_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("duration_sec"), 2).alias("avg_duration_sec"),
        F.round(F.sum("status_code") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "auth", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("status_code_per_auth"),
    )
    .orderBy("row_count")
)

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        QUARTER(event_time) event_time_quarter
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IN ('/cart', '/home', '/checkout')
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time_quarter DESC, id) AS rn
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        event_time_quarter,
        rn,
        MAX(duration_sec) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) duration_sec_max_7d,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_duration_sec,
        LAST_VALUE(page) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_page,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page, session_id ORDER BY event_time_quarter, id) event_seq
    FROM deduped
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN event_seq >= 6 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS event_seq_tier,
    MAX(running_duration_sec) AS max_running_duration_sec,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_time)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_time))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT page) AS distinct_pages,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(event_seq, 0.9) AS event_seq_p90,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/product' THEN 1 END) AS product_count
FROM scored
GROUP BY 1;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("event_time_quarter").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("page", "session_id").orderBy("event_time_quarter", "id")

valid = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isin(["/cart", "/home", "/checkout"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        F.quarter("event_time").alias("event_time_quarter"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("duration_sec").over(w2).alias("duration_sec_max_7d"),
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(w3).alias("running_duration_sec"),
        F.last("page", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("last_known_page"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("event_seq") >= 6, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("event_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("running_duration_sec").alias("max_running_duration_sec"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("event_time")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("event_time"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.countDistinct("page").alias("distinct_pages"),
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq", 0.9).alias("event_seq_p90"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/product", 1)).alias("product_count"),
    )
)

with valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, unit_price - quantity line_total
    from order_items
    where unit_price >= 370
),
filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        cast(quantity as double) quantity_str,
        line_total + unit_price line_total_plus_unit_price
    from valid
    where product_id is not null
),
deduped as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from filtered
    qualify row_number() over (partition by order_id, product_id order by line_total_plus_unit_price desc, id) = 1
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select
        e.*,
        d.brand,
        d.product_name,
        d.price
    from deduped e
    join products d
        on e.product_id = d.id
),
enriched_order_items as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        lag(price, 2) over (partition by brand order by quantity, id) prev_price,
        lead(quantity_str, 1) over w_recent next_quantity_str,
        lag(line_total, 1) over w_part prev_line_total,
        avg(line_total) over (order by quantity_str, id rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) line_total_avg_3_prior
    from enriched
    window w_recent as (partition by product_id order by line_total, id), w_part as (partition by order_id, brand order by line_total, id)
),
enriched_order_items_2 as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select a.*, p.category
    from enriched_order_items a
    left join products p
        on a.product_id = p.id
),
stats as (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    select
        order_id,
        count(*) as row_count,
        count(distinct order_id) as distinct_order_ids,
        bit_and(quantity) as quantity_bit_and,
        percentile_approx(next_quantity_str, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as next_quantity_str_quartiles
    from enriched_order_items_2
    group by cube (order_id)
)
select
    s.order_id,
    s.row_count,
    s.distinct_order_ids,
    s.quantity_bit_and,
    s.next_quantity_str_quartiles,
    (select sum(x.amount) from payments x where x.order_id = s.order_id) as sum_payment_amount
from stats s
order by sum_payment_amount;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("line_total_plus_unit_price").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("quantity", "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("line_total", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "brand").orderBy("line_total", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("quantity_str", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
amount_by_order_id = df_payments.groupBy("order_id").agg(F.sum("amount").alias("sum_payment_amount"))

valid = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("unit_price") >= 370)
    .withColumn("line_total", (F.col("unit_price") - F.col("quantity")))
)

filtered = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("quantity").cast("double").alias("quantity_str"),
        (F.col("line_total") + F.col("unit_price")).alias("line_total_plus_unit_price"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.brand"), F.col("d.product_name"), F.col("d.price"))
)

enriched_order_items = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("price", 2).over(w2).alias("prev_price"),
        F.lead("quantity_str", 1).over(w_recent).alias("next_quantity_str"),
        F.lag("line_total", 1).over(w_part).alias("prev_line_total"),
        F.avg("line_total").over(w5).alias("line_total_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

enriched_order_items_2 = (
    enriched_order_items
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.category"))
)

stats = (
    enriched_order_items_2
    .cube("order_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("distinct_order_ids"),
        F.bit_and("quantity").alias("quantity_bit_and"),
        F.percentile_approx("next_quantity_str", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("next_quantity_str_quartiles"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .join(amount_by_order_id, on="order_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "order_id",
        "row_count",
        "distinct_order_ids",
        "quantity_bit_and",
        "next_quantity_str_quartiles",
        F.col("sum_payment_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy("sum_payment_amount")
)

with base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        cost,
        datediff(delivered_date, shipped_date) as days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date,
        round(cost * 1.15, 2) as adjusted_cost,
        coalesce(carrier, 'OTHER') as carrier_filled
    from shipments
    where delivered_date > date '2023-08-24'
),
joined as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        a.*,
        b.order_date,
        b.status,
        b.shipping_fee
    from base a
    left join orders b
        on a.order_id = b.id
),
joined_shipments as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select e.*, b.status as order_status
    from joined e
    join orders b
        on e.order_id = b.id
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        round(cost / sum(cost) over (partition by status), 4) as cost_share,
        sum(shipping_fee) over (partition by status order by order_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_shipping_fee
    from joined_shipments
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as quarter_start,
    count(*) filter (where status = 'CANCELLED') as cancelled_rows,
    count(*) filter (where order_status = 'CANCELLED') as cancelled_rows_2,
    sort_array(collect_set(order_status)) as order_status_list
from enriched
group by quarter_start
having cancelled_rows_2 >= 1
order by quarter_start desc nulls last

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-08-24").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "cost",
        F.datediff("delivered_date", "shipped_date").alias("days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") * 1.15), 2).alias("adjusted_cost"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

joined = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.order_date"), F.col("b.status"), F.col("b.shipping_fee"))
)

joined_shipments = (
    joined
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.status").alias("order_status"))
)

enriched = (
    joined_shipments
    .withColumn("cost_share", F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(w)), 4))
    .withColumn("cumulative_shipping_fee", F.sum("shipping_fee").over(w2))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("quarter", "order_date").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "CANCELLED", 1)).alias("cancelled_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("order_status") == "CANCELLED", 1)).alias("cancelled_rows_2"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("order_status")).alias("order_status_list"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cancelled_rows_2") >= 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("quarter_start").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH valid_inventory AS (

    FROM inventory
    WHERE quantity BETWEEN 169 AND 235 AND quantity BETWEEN 66 AND 156

quantity_bucket_summary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN quantity >= 192 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 116 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS quantity_bucket, ROUND(STDDEV(quantity), 2) AS stddev_quantity, MIN(last_restock) AS min_last_restock

sql:
with deduped as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by supplier_id order by launch_date desc, id) as latest_rank
        from products
    ) t
    where latest_rank = 1
),
joined as (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    select
        s.*,
        p2.rating,
        p2.country
    from deduped s
    left join suppliers p2
        on s.supplier_id = p2.id
),
with_last as (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.*,
        top1.unit_price,
        top1.order_item_quantity
    from joined s
    left join lateral (
            select c.unit_price, c.quantity as order_item_quantity
            from order_items c
            where c.product_id = s.id
            order by c.unit_price desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
)
select
    id,
    product_name,
    price,
    cost,
    stock_qty,
    launch_date,
    tags,
    latest_rank,
    country
from with_last
order by price nulls last, country desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id").orderBy(F.col("launch_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.unit_price").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

deduped = (
    df_products
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

joined = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("p2"), F.col("s.supplier_id") == F.col("p2.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p2.rating"), F.col("p2.country"))
)

with_last = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.unit_price"),
        F.col("c.quantity").alias("order_item_quantity"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_last
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_name",
        "price",
        "cost",
        "stock_qty",
        "launch_date",
        "tags",
        "latest_rank",
        "country",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("price").asc_nulls_last(), F.col("country").desc())
)

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating NULLS LAST, id) AS rn
    FROM suppliers
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(rating, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY rn, id) AS prev_rating,
        ROUND(rating / SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city, country), 4) AS rating_share
    FROM ranked
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating DESC, id) AS rating_bucket,
        COUNT(prev_rating) OVER w_ordered AS country_count_prev_rating,
        AVG(prev_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY prev_rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev_rating_avg_6,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating_share NULLS LAST) AS rating_share_cume_dist,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating_share, id) AS rating_share_bucket
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY country)
),
with_latest AS (
    SELECT s.*, top1.product_stock_qty
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.stock_qty AS product_stock_qty
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        rating - product_stock_qty AS rating_minus_product_stock_qty,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS city_filled
    FROM with_latest
    WHERE country = 'US'
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(prev_rating_avg_6, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id) AS next_prev_rating_avg_6,
        FIRST_VALUE(rating_share_bucket) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating_share_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_rating_share_bucket,
        AVG(country_count_prev_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating_share, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS country_count_prev_rating_avg_3_prior,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prev_rating NULLS LAST) AS prev_rating_percent_rank,
        SUM(country_count_prev_rating) OVER (ORDER BY prev_rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_country_count_prev_rating
    FROM base
),
latest_match AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.cost,
        top1.stock_qty
    FROM enriched s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.cost, c.stock_qty
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.launch_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN cost >= 750 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS cost_tier,
    country,
    CASE WHEN prev_rating_percent_rank >= 0.86 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS prev_rating_percent_rank_tier,
    MAX(country_count_prev_rating_avg_3_prior) FILTER (WHERE country = 'DE') AS de_max_country_count_prev_rating_avg_3_prior,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS num_countries,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_id
FROM latest_match
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN cost >= 750 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, country, CASE WHEN prev_rating_percent_rank >= 0.86 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END)
ORDER BY prev_rating_percent_rank_tier

w14 = Window.orderBy("prev_rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

latest_match = (

        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("country")).alias("country_list"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("country")).alias("num_countries"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .orderBy("prev_rating_percent_rank_tier")
)

with deduped as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from device_readings
    qualify row_number() over (partition by device_code order by pressure desc, id asc) = 1
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when reading_ts - lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts asc, id asc) > interval 15 minutes then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from deduped
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id
    from gaps
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        is_new_session,
        session_id,
        row_number() over (partition by device_code order by status_bits asc, id asc) as row_seq,
        avg(is_new_session) over (partition by device_code order by is_new_session asc, id asc rows between 6 preceding and current row) as is_new_session_avg_6,
        avg(humidity) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts asc, id asc rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) as humidity_avg_5_prior,
        corr(pressure, status_bits) over (partition by device_code) as corr_pressure_status_bits,
        max(is_new_session) over (partition by device_code order by cast(reading_ts as bigint) asc range between 3600 preceding and current row) as is_new_session_max_1h
    from islands
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select firmware, id
    from enriched
    except
    select firmware, id
    from device_readings
    where hour(reading_ts) between 7 and 13
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from enriched s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.firmware = k.firmware and s.id = k.id
),
enriched_device_readings as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        is_new_session,
        session_id,
        row_seq,
        is_new_session_avg_6,
        humidity_avg_5_prior,
        corr_pressure_status_bits,
        is_new_session_max_1h,
        round(humidity / sum(humidity) over (partition by device_code), 4) as humidity_share,
        rank() over (partition by device_code order by temp_c asc nulls last) as temp_c_rank,
        count(row_seq) over (partition by device_code order by cast(reading_ts as bigint) asc range between 7200 preceding and current row) as row_seq_count_2h,
        rank() over (partition by device_code order by corr_pressure_status_bits asc nulls first) as corr_pressure_status_bits_rank,
        count(is_new_session_max_1h) over (partition by device_code) as device_code_count_is_new_session_max_1h
    from verified
),
cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        is_new_session,
        session_id,
        row_seq,
        is_new_session_avg_6,
        humidity_avg_5_prior,
        corr_pressure_status_bits,
        is_new_session_max_1h,
        temp_c_rank,
        row_seq_count_2h,
        device_code_count_is_new_session_max_1h,
        lower(firmware) as firmware_lower
    from enriched_device_readings
    where reading_ts >= date '2025-09-01'
      and humidity_avg_5_prior <> 54
),
stats as (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    select
        case when is_new_session_max_1h >= 1 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as is_new_session_max_1h_tier,
        avg(is_new_session_avg_6) as avg_is_new_session_avg_6,
        count_if(device_code = 'DV-02') as dv_02_events,
        max(status_bits) filter (where device_code = 'DV-03') as dv_03_max_status_bits
    from cleaned
    group by is_new_session_max_1h_tier
)
select
    is_new_session_max_1h_tier,
    avg_is_new_session_avg_6,
    dv_02_events,
    dv_03_max_status_bits
from stats
order by avg_is_new_session_avg_6 desc

w9 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").asc_nulls_last())
w10 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)

)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w3))

    .select(

        F.corr("pressure", "status_bits").over(w7).alias("corr_pressure_status_bits"),

    )
)

kept_keys = (

    .select("firmware", "id")
    .subtract(

        .select("firmware", "id")
    )

verified = (

)

enriched_device_readings = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("humidity") / F.sum("humidity").over(w7)), 4).alias("humidity_share"),
        F.rank().over(w9).alias("temp_c_rank"),
        F.count("row_seq").over(w10).alias("row_seq_count_2h"),
        F.rank().over(w11).alias("corr_pressure_status_bits_rank"),
        F.count("is_new_session_max_1h").over(w7).alias("device_code_count_is_new_session_max_1h"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched_device_readings
    .filter((F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date")) & (F.col("humidity_avg_5_prior") != 54))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "is_new_session",
        "session_id",
        "row_seq",
        "is_new_session_avg_6",
        "humidity_avg_5_prior",
        "corr_pressure_status_bits",
        "is_new_session_max_1h",
        "temp_c_rank",
        "row_seq_count_2h",
        "device_code_count_is_new_session_max_1h",
        F.lower("firmware").alias("firmware_lower"),
    )
)

stats = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("is_new_session_max_1h") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("is_new_session_max_1h_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("is_new_session_avg_6").alias("avg_is_new_session_avg_6"),
        F.count_if(F.col("device_code") == "DV-02").alias("dv_02_events"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-03", F.col("status_bits"))).alias("dv_03_max_status_bits"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "is_new_session_max_1h_tier",
        "avg_is_new_session_avg_6",
        "dv_02_events",
        "dv_03_max_status_bits",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_is_new_session_avg_6").desc())

WITH parsed AS (

        CAST((status_code & 8) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged,
        FROM_JSON(payload_json, 'STRUCT<user: STRUCT<id: INT, tier: STRING>, duration: DOUBLE, retries: INT, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>').retries AS retry_count,

SELECT

    MIN(log_ts) AS first_log_ts,
    MIN(latency_ms) AS min_latency_ms,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    MIN(log_ts) AS first_seen
FROM parsed
GROUP BY hour_window;

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(tier_prices) e AS tier_value
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, currency
    FROM lines
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, currency
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE currency IN ('USD', 'THB', 'EUR')
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM lines s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.currency = k.currency
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value,
        AVG(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY plan, currency) AS plan_avg_tier_value,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value) AS tier_value_dense_rank
    FROM verified
),
kept_keys_2 AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT currency
    FROM with_windows
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT currency
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE plan = 'basic'
),
verified_price_tiers AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys_2 k ON s.currency = k.currency
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN tier_value_dense_rank >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS tier_value_dense_rank_tier,
    currency,
    SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'pro' THEN tier_value ELSE 0 END) AS pro_tier_value,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'starter' THEN 1 END) AS starter_count,
    ROUND(AVG(tier_value), 2) AS avg_tier_value
FROM verified_price_tiers
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'pro' THEN tier_value ELSE 0 END) < 0

WITH remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, channel
    FROM orders
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id, channel
    FROM orders
    WHERE channel = 'partner'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM orders s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.channel = k.channel
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct
    FROM kept_rows e
    INNER JOIN promotions pr
        ON e.channel = pr.channel
       AND e.order_date BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_window s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items x
            WHERE x.order_id = s.id
              AND x.unit_price IS NOT NULL
        )
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.paid_at >= '2025-11-01'
        )
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN discount >= 0.33 THEN 'High' WHEN discount >= 0.09 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS discount_band,
        COALESCE(channel, 'N/A') AS channel_filled
    FROM eligible
    WHERE channel NOT IN ('store', 'web')
),
wide AS (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            promo_code,
            channel,
            discount_pct
        FROM valid
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        MAX(discount_pct) AS amount,
        COUNT(1) AS n
        FOR channel IN ('store', 'partner', 'web')
    )
)
SELECT
    promo_code,
    store_amount,
    partner_amount,
    partner_n,
    web_amount,
    web_n
FROM wide
ORDER BY promo_code

    where rn = 1

    qualify row_number() over (partition by country order by rating desc nulls first, id) = 1

    select

            select c.launch_date, c.stock_qty

WITH filtered AS (

    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(full_name, 1, 4) AS full_name_prefix
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(level) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_level,
        AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY level, job_title) AS level_avg_salary,
        LAG(salary, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY hire_date, id) AS prev_salary
    FROM filtered
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(salary, 1) OVER w_part AS prev_salary_2,
        LEAD(salary, 1) OVER w_ordered AS next_salary,
        MAX(level_avg_salary) OVER w_hist AS level_max_level_avg_salary,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary DESC, id) AS salary_bucket
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY hire_date, id), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY level_avg_salary, id), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY level, job_title)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.budget,
        b.dept_name
    FROM with_windows src
    JOIN departments b
        ON src.dept_id = b.id
),
with_dims_employees AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        e.level AS employee_level,
        e.salary AS employee_salary
    FROM with_dims s
    LEFT JOIN employees e
        ON s.manager_id = e.id
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT level
    FROM with_dims_employees
    INTERSECT
    SELECT level
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NULL
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims_employees s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.level = k.level
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.full_name,
    s.email,
    s.dept_id,
    s.job_title,
    s.hire_date,
    s.is_remote,
    s.full_name_prefix,

    (SELECT MAX(t2.salary) FROM employees t2 WHERE t2.dept_id = s.dept_id) AS max_employee_salary
FROM kept_rows s
ORDER BY max_employee_salary DESC NULLS FIRST;

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("level_avg_salary", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("salary").desc(), "id")
salary_by_dept_id = df_employees.groupBy("dept_id").agg(F.max("salary").alias("max_employee_salary"))

filtered = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("manager_id").isNull())
    .select("*", F.substring("full_name", 1, 4).alias("full_name_prefix"))

scored = (

    .withColumn("last_known_level", F.last("level", ignorenulls=True).over(w))
    .withColumn("level_avg_salary", F.avg("salary").over(w2))
    .withColumn("prev_salary", F.lag("salary", 1).over(w3))
)

with_windows = (

    .withColumn("prev_salary_2", F.lag("salary", 1).over(w_part))
    .withColumn("next_salary", F.lead("salary", 1).over(w_ordered))

WITH base AS (

        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        SUBSTRING(channel, 1, 2) AS channel_prefix
    FROM promotions
    WHERE starts_on > DATE '2023-06-15'
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *, CONCAT(channel, ' - ', promo_code) AS channel_promo_code
    FROM base
    WHERE starts_on > DATE '2024-03-03'
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
      AND channel = 'web'
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_discount_pct,
        LAG(discount_pct, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY ends_on, id) AS prev_discount_pct
    FROM filtered
),
base_promotions AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        channel_prefix,
        channel_promo_code,
        prev_discount_pct,
        CAST(cumulative_discount_pct AS DOUBLE) AS cumulative_discount_pct_num
    FROM metrics
    WHERE ends_on <= '2025-05-29'
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', starts_on) AS year_start,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS channel_list,
        SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN discount_pct ELSE 0 END) AS store_discount_pct,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS channel_list_2,
        SUM(discount_pct) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') AS store_total_discount_pct
    FROM base_promotions
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', starts_on)
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 1
)
SELECT
    year_start,
    channel_list,
    channel_list_2,
    store_total_discount_pct
FROM stats;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy("ends_on", "id")

base = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("starts_on") > F.lit("2023-06-15").cast("date")) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.substring("channel", 1, 2).alias("channel_prefix"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("starts_on") > F.lit("2024-03-03").cast("date")) & F.col("channel").isNotNull() & (F.col("channel") == "web"))
    .withColumn("channel_promo_code", F.concat("channel", F.lit(" - "), "promo_code"))
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("cumulative_discount_pct", F.sum("discount_pct").over(w))
    .withColumn("prev_discount_pct", F.lag("discount_pct", 2).over(w2))
)

base_promotions = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("ends_on") <= "2025-05-29")
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "channel_prefix",
        "channel_promo_code",
        "prev_discount_pct",
        F.col("cumulative_discount_pct").cast("double").alias("cumulative_discount_pct_num"),
    )
)

stats = (
    base_promotions
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "starts_on").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "store", F.col("discount_pct")).otherwise(0)).alias("store_discount_pct"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list_2"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "store", F.col("discount_pct"))).alias("store_total_discount_pct"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cnt") < 1)
)

result = (
    stats
    .select("year_start", "channel_list", "channel_list_2", "store_total_discount_pct")
)

WITH filtered AS (
