        WEEKOFYEAR(sale_date) AS sale_date_weekofyear
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE YEAR(sale_date) >= 2023
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(revenue_filled / units, 2) AS revenue_filled_per_units,
        ROUND(revenue, 1) AS revenue_rounded
    FROM filtered
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2024-04-05'
      AND revenue > 2500
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY sale_date DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rn
    FROM base
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        revenue_filled,
        sale_date_weekofyear,
        revenue_rounded,
        rn,
        units * revenue_filled_per_units AS units_times_revenue_filled_per_units
    FROM ranked
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2024-02-29'
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN sale_date_weekofyear >= 67 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS sale_date_weekofyear_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(sale_date_weekofyear), 2) AS avg_sale_date_weekofyear,
    BIT_OR(units) AS units_bit_or,
    ROUND(AVG(sale_date_weekofyear), 2) AS avg_sale_date_weekofyear_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_product_ids,
    BIT_OR(units) AS units_bit_or_2
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY 1

        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_page"),
    )
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

base_web_events = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "duration_sec",
        "resolved_page",
        "row_num",
        F.least("duration_sec_scaled", "row_num").alias("least_duration_sec_scaled_row_num"),
        F.col("row_num").cast("double").alias("row_num_num"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    base_web_events
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("d"), F.col("src.session_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("d.browser"), F.col("d.country"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("p"), F.col("src.session_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.country").alias("session_country"), F.col("p.device"))
)

matched_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("session_id", "event_type")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("event_time") < "2025-03-01")
        .select("session_id", "event_type")
    )
)

verified = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("k.session_id")) & (F.col("s.event_type") == F.col("k.event_type")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("least_duration_sec_scaled_row_num").over(w2).alias("browser_sum_least_duration_sec_scaled_row_num"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("duration_sec_cume_dist"),
        F.rank().over(w_recent).alias("row_num_num_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .withColumn("duration_sec_cume_dist_tier", F.when(F.col("duration_sec_cume_dist") >= 0.72, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("least_duration_sec_scaled_row_num_tier", F.when(F.col("least_duration_sec_scaled_row_num") >= 89, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["device", "duration_sec_cume_dist_tier", "least_duration_sec_scaled_row_num_tier"], ["device", "duration_sec_cume_dist_tier"], ["device"], []],
        "device",
        "duration_sec_cume_dist_tier",
        "least_duration_sec_scaled_row_num_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device") == "desktop", 1)).alias("desktop_rows"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("device")).alias("num_devices"),
        F.bit_and("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_bit_and"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.grouping("device").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        CASE WHEN country = 'TH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_th
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date >= TO_DATE('2023-10-23')
      AND city IS NOT NULL
      AND LENGTH(email) < 9
),
cleaned_customers AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        TRIM(name) AS clean_name,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(email, '@(.+)$', 1) AS email_domain
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE signup_date >= TO_DATE('2024-01-09')
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching order per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.order_status
    FROM cleaned_customers s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.status AS order_status
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.discount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM latest_match
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY signup_date DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        clean_name,
        email_domain,
        order_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, order_status ORDER BY signup_date, id) AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(order_status, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY city, order_status ORDER BY signup_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_order_status,
        FIRST_VALUE(city, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY signup_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_city,
        LAST_VALUE(order_status, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY order_status ORDER BY signup_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_order_status
    FROM deduped
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', signup_date) AS activity_month,
    CASE WHEN seq_no >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS seq_no_tier,
    SUM(seq_no) AS total_seq_no,
    ROUND(AVG(seq_no), 2) AS avg_seq_no,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(seq_no, 0.5) AS seq_no_p50,
    GROUPING(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', signup_date)) AS grouping_level
FROM metrics
GROUP BY ROLLUP (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', signup_date), CASE WHEN seq_no >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END)
HAVING seq_no_p50 >= 0;

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS k, value
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY latency_ms, id, k) AS dedup_rank
    FROM flattened
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT host, level
    FROM deduped
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT host, level
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE status_code BETWEEN 344 AND 404
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.host = k.host AND s.level = k.level
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        value,
        dedup_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms DESC NULLS FIRST) latency_ms_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_grp latency_ms_dense_rank_2
    FROM kept_rows
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY latency_ms NULLS FIRST)
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        value,
        dedup_rank,
        latency_ms_dense_rank,
        latency_ms_dense_rank_2,
        INITCAP(TRIM(host)) host_title,
        COALESCE(k, 'NONE') resolved_k
    FROM enriched
    WHERE log_ts > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 11:00:00'
      AND k IS NOT NULL
      AND dedup_rank < 1
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    k,
    level,
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts) AS activity_day,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(log_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(log_ts))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(log_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(log_ts))) / 60 AS span_minutes_2,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(level)) AS level_list,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(level)) AS level_list_2,
    MAX(log_ts) AS last_log_ts,
    GROUPING(k) AS gid
FROM valid
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((k, level, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts)), (k, level), (k));

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "k")

    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",

        "level",

deduped = (

    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))

remaining_keys = (

    .select("host", "level")
    .exceptAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("status_code").between(344, 404))
        .select("host", "level")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.host") == F.col("k.host")) & (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")

enriched = (

    .select(

valid = (

    .select(

        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",

result = (

        "level",
        "activity_day",
    )
    .agg(
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("log_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("log_ts"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("log_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("log_ts"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes_2"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("level")).alias("level_list"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("level")).alias("level_list_2"),
        F.max("log_ts").alias("last_log_ts"),
        F.grouping("k").alias("gid"),
    )
)

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_running AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time DESC, id) AS row_seq
    FROM web_events
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id)
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN row_seq >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS row_seq_tier,
    session_id,
    page,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_event_time,
    AVG(event_seq) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'search') AS search_avg_event_seq,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(event_seq, 0.5) AS event_seq_p50,
    BIT_OR(duration_sec) AS duration_sec_bit_or,
    ROUND(SUM(duration_sec) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/cart' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS duration_sec_per_cart,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN row_seq >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, session_id, page;

)

sql: WITH account_summary AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'REFUND' THEN 1 END) AS refund_count, MIN(amount) AS min_amount FROM transactions WHERE is_flagged GROUP BY account_id) SELECT accounts.id, accounts.opened_date, account_summary.refund_count, account_summary.min_amount FROM accounts INNER JOIN account_summary ON accounts.id = account_summary.account_id ORDER BY accounts.opened_date;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

account_summary = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged"))
    .groupBy("account_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "REFUND", 1)).alias("refund_count"),
        F.min("amount").alias("min_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_accounts.alias("accounts")
    .join(account_summary.alias("account_summary"), F.col("accounts.id") == F.col("account_summary.account_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        F.col("accounts.id"),
        F.col("accounts.opened_date"),
        F.col("account_summary.refund_count"),
        F.col("account_summary.min_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy("opened_date")
)

sql:
WITH deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY cost DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM products
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
              AND c.unit_price BETWEEN 130 AND 300
        )
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        rank_in_group,
        rank_in_group + cost AS rank_in_group_plus_cost
    FROM not_flagged
    WHERE launch_date > DATE '2024-03-12'
      AND supplier_id IS NOT NULL
      AND category IN ('Home', 'Sports')
),
summary AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN price >= 1260 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS price_tier,
        category,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count_2,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(cost, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS cost_quartiles,
        SUM(price) FILTER (WHERE brand = 'Acme') AS acme_total_price,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(category)) AS num_categories
    FROM cleaned
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    price_tier,
    category,
    event_count,
    cost_quartiles,
    acme_total_price
FROM summary;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")

deduped = (
    df_products
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

not_flagged = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.unit_price").between(130, 300)), "left_anti")
)

cleaned = (
    not_flagged
    .filter((F.col("launch_date") > F.lit("2024-03-12").cast("date")) & F.col("supplier_id").isNotNull() & F.col("category").isin(["Home", "Sports"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "brand",
        "price",
        "cost",
        "stock_qty",
        "launch_date",
        "tags",
        "supplier_id",
        "rank_in_group",
        (F.col("rank_in_group") + F.col("cost")).alias("rank_in_group_plus_cost"),
    )
)

summary = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("price") >= 1260, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("price_tier"),
        "category",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count_2"),
        F.percentile_approx("cost", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("cost_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("brand") == "Acme", F.col("price"))).alias("acme_total_price"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("category")).alias("num_categories"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "price_tier",
        "category",
        "event_count",
        "cost_quartiles",
        "acme_total_price",
    )
)

with eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from sessions s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from web_events c
            where c.session_id = s.id
              and c.event_time < s.started_at
        )
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        first_value(country, true) over (partition by country order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_country,
        row_number() over w_running as seq_no,
        row_number() over (partition by browser, customer_id order by started_at desc, id) as seq_no_2,
        row_number() over w_running_2 as seq_no_3
    from eligible
    window w_running as (partition by browser, country order by started_at desc, id), w_running_2 as (partition by device order by started_at desc, id)
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by device order by seq_no_2 desc, id) as row_seq,
        first_value(country) ignore nulls over (order by seq_no_3, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_country_2,
        round(seq_no / sum(seq_no) over (partition by device), 4) as seq_no_share
    from scored
),
wide as (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    select *
    from (
        select
            customer_id,
            device,
            seq_no_share
        from enriched
    ) src
    pivot (
        avg(seq_no_share) as total
        for device in ('mobile', 'tablet')
    )
)
select
    customer_id,
    mobile,
    tablet
from wide
order by mobile desc nulls first
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("browser", "country").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("browser", "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w_running_2 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy(F.col("seq_no_2").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy("seq_no_3", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("device")

eligible = (
    df_sessions
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.event_time") < F.col("s.started_at")), "left_anti")
)

scored = (
    eligible
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("first_known_country"),
        F.row_number().over(w_running).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("seq_no_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w_running_2).alias("seq_no_3"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("row_seq"),
        F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("first_known_country_2"),
        F.round((F.col("seq_no") / F.sum("seq_no").over(w7)), 4).alias("seq_no_share"),
    )
)

wide = (
    enriched
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .pivot("device", ["mobile", "tablet"])
    .agg(F.avg("seq_no_share").alias("total"))
)

result = (
    wide
    .select("customer_id", "mobile", "tablet")
    .orderBy(F.col("mobile").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT(job_title, '/', level) AS job_title_level,
        ROUND(salary, 2) AS salary_rounded
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date > DATE '2023-09-03'
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(salary_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title) AS job_title_stddev_samp_salary_rounded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary_rounded DESC, id ASC) AS seq_no,
        AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id) AS dept_id_avg_salary,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_recent AS salary_rounded_percent_rank
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY job_title, dept_id ORDER BY salary_rounded DESC NULLS FIRST)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        job_title_level,
        job_title_stddev_samp_salary_rounded,
        seq_no,
        dept_id_avg_salary,
        salary_rounded_percent_rank,
        job_title_stddev_samp_salary_rounded + dept_id_avg_salary AS job_title_stddev_samp_salary_rounded_plus_dept_id_avg_salary
    FROM scored
    WHERE hire_date > DATE '2023-11-01'
      AND job_title IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(salary / SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, job_title), 4) AS salary_share,
        LAG(seq_no, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC) AS prev_seq_no,
        SUM(dept_id_avg_salary) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_dept_id_avg_salary,
        AVG(salary_rounded_percent_rank) OVER (ORDER BY dept_id_avg_salary ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS salary_rounded_percent_rank_avg_3_prior,
        ROUND(seq_no / SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, job_title), 4) AS seq_no_share
    FROM cleaned
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    id,
    full_name,
    email,
    manager_id,
    job_title,
    salary,
    hire_date,
    is_remote,
    job_title_level,
    job_title_stddev_samp_salary_rounded,
    seq_no,
    dept_id_avg_salary,
    salary_rounded_percent_rank,
    job_title_stddev_samp_salary_rounded_plus_dept_id_avg_salary,
    salary_share,
    prev_seq_no,
    cumulative_dept_id_avg_salary,
    salary_rounded_percent_rank_avg_3_prior,
    seq_no_share,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary_share ASC NULLS FIRST) AS salary_share_dense_rank,
    NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY cumulative_dept_id_avg_salary ASC, id ASC) AS cumulative_dept_id_avg_salary_bucket,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary_rounded_percent_rank DESC, id ASC) AS event_seq
FROM metrics;

select
    date_trunc('quarter', last_restock) as quarter_start,
    case when last_known_quantity >= 243 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as last_known_quantity_tier,
    max(quantity_avg_6) as max_quantity_avg_6,
    count(*) as event_count,
    grouping(date_trunc('quarter', last_restock)) as gid
from ranked
group by grouping sets ((date_trunc('quarter', last_restock), case when last_known_quantity >= 243 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end), (date_trunc('quarter', last_restock)))
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy("last_restock", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_bucket_2").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

cleaned = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-10-17").cast("date")) & F.col("product_id").isin([1, 4, 6]))
    .select("*", F.add_months("last_restock", 3).alias("last_restock_plus_months"))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("last_known_quantity", F.last("quantity", ignorenulls=True).over(w))
    .withColumn("quantity_avg_6", F.avg("quantity").over(w2))
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(5).over(w_grp).alias("quantity_bucket"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("quantity_rank"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w5).alias("quantity_bucket_2"),
        F.lag("quantity", 1).over(w6).alias("prev_quantity"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

result = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("quarter", "last_restock"))
    .withColumn("last_known_quantity_tier", F.when(F.col("last_known_quantity") >= 243, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["quarter_start", "last_known_quantity_tier"], ["quarter_start"]],
        "quarter_start",
        "last_known_quantity_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("quantity_avg_6").alias("max_quantity_avg_6"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.grouping("quarter_start").alias("gid"),
    )
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS k, value
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        value,
        CONCAT_WS('-', k, level) k_level_key,
        UPPER(level) level_upper
    FROM lines
    WHERE latency_ms <= 1200
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k, level ORDER BY latency_ms, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) latency_ms_avg_3_prior,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms DESC NULLS FIRST) latency_ms_rank,
        AVG(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY level) level_avg_latency_ms
    FROM cleaned
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        k,
        value,
        level_upper,
        latency_ms_avg_3_prior,
        latency_ms_rank,
        level_avg_latency_ms,
        latency_ms_rank + latency_ms latency_ms_rank_plus_latency_ms,
        COALESCE(k, 'OTHER') resolved_k
    FROM enriched
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_running latency_ms_avg_3_prior_bucket,
        AVG(latency_ms_rank_plus_latency_ms) OVER w_grp latency_ms_rank_plus_latency_ms_avg_3,
        LAG(latency_ms_avg_3_prior, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY latency_ms_rank_plus_latency_ms, id, k) prev_latency_ms_avg_3_prior
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms_avg_3_prior DESC, id, k), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY k, level ORDER BY latency_ms_avg_3_prior, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(level_avg_latency_ms, 2) OVER (ORDER BY prev_latency_ms_avg_3_prior, id, k) prev_level_avg_latency_ms,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY prev_latency_ms_avg_3_prior, id, k) prev_latency_ms_avg_3_prior_bucket
    FROM metrics
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms_rank DESC, id, k) row_seq,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms_avg_3_prior_bucket DESC, id, k) row_seq_2
FROM scored

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k", "level").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "k").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_avg_3_prior").desc(), "id", "k")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("k", "level").orderBy("latency_ms_avg_3_prior", "id", "k").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("latency_ms_rank_plus_latency_ms", "id", "k")
w7 = Window.orderBy("prev_latency_ms_avg_3_prior", "id", "k")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("prev_latency_ms_avg_3_prior", "id", "k")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_rank").desc(), "id", "k")
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_avg_3_prior_bucket").desc(), "id", "k")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms") <= 1200)
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        "value",
        F.concat_ws("-", "k", "level").alias("k_level_key"),
        F.upper("level").alias("level_upper"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("latency_ms_avg_3_prior", F.avg("latency_ms").over(w))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("level_avg_latency_ms", F.avg("latency_ms").over(w3))
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "k",
        "value",
        "level_upper",
        "latency_ms_avg_3_prior",
        "latency_ms_rank",
        "level_avg_latency_ms",
        (F.col("latency_ms_rank") + F.col("latency_ms")).alias("latency_ms_rank_plus_latency_ms"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_k"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(5).over(w_running).alias("latency_ms_avg_3_prior_bucket"),
        F.avg("latency_ms_rank_plus_latency_ms").over(w_grp).alias("latency_ms_rank_plus_latency_ms_avg_3"),
        F.lag("latency_ms_avg_3_prior", 1, 0).over(w6).alias("prev_latency_ms_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("level_avg_latency_ms", 2).over(w7).alias("prev_level_avg_latency_ms"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w8).alias("prev_latency_ms_avg_3_prior_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w9))
    .withColumn("row_seq_2", F.row_number().over(w10))
)

sql: WITH remaining_keys AS (SELECT product_id FROM store_sales EXCEPT ALL SELECT product_id FROM store_sales WHERE store_id IN (2, 3, 6)), reconciled AS (SELECT s.* FROM store_sales s INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', sale_date) AS activity_month, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', sale_date) AS week_start, CASE WHEN revenue >= 3800 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS revenue_tier, APPROX_PERCENTILE(revenue, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS revenue_quartiles, BIT_AND(units) AS units_bit_and, APPROX_PERCENTILE(revenue, 0.5) AS revenue_p50, APPROX_PERCENTILE(units, 0.95) AS units_p95, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_product_ids, STDDEV_SAMP(units) AS units_stddev FROM reconciled GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', sale_date), DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', sale_date), CASE WHEN revenue >= 3800 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

remaining_keys = (
    df_store_sales
    .select("product_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([2, 3, 6]))
        .select("product_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_store_sales
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "sale_date").alias("activity_month"),
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "sale_date").alias("week_start"),
        F.when(F.col("revenue") >= 3800, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("revenue_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("revenue", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("revenue_quartiles"),
        F.bit_and("units").alias("units_bit_and"),
        F.percentile_approx("revenue", 0.5).alias("revenue_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("units", 0.95).alias("units_p95"),
        F.countDistinct("product_id").alias("distinct_product_ids"),
        F.stddev_samp("units").alias("units_stddev"),
    )
)

WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        currency,
        tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(tier_limits) x AS tier_value
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(tier_value, 0) AS tier_value_rounded,
        COALESCE(tier_value, 0) AS tier_value_filled
    FROM exploded
    WHERE tier_value >= 41
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_count_tier_value,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value_filled) AS tier_value_filled_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value DESC) AS tier_value_cume_dist
    FROM cleaned
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY currency_count_tier_value) AS currency_count_tier_value_cume_dist,
        AVG(tier_value_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_avg_tier_value_cume_dist,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_grp AS tier_value_rounded_percent_rank
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value_rounded)
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN currency_avg_tier_value_cume_dist >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS currency_avg_tier_value_cume_dist_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(tier_value_rounded_percent_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS tier_value_rounded_percent_rank_quartiles,
    ROUND(SUM(currency_count_tier_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS currency_count_tier_value_per_eur,
    MAX(tier_value_filled_rank) AS max_tier_value_filled_rank,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(currency)) AS num_currencies,
    AVG(currency_count_tier_value) AS avg_currency_count_tier_value,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(currency_count_tier_value_cume_dist, 0.95) AS currency_count_tier_value_cume_dist_p95,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN currency_avg_tier_value_cume_dist >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END) AS grouping_id
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN currency_avg_tier_value_cume_dist >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
HAVING MAX(tier_value_filled_rank) >= 0
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("tier_value_filled")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("currency_count_tier_value")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("tier_value_rounded")

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "currency", F.explode("tier_limits").alias("tier_value"))
)

cleaned = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("tier_value") >= 41)
    .withColumn("tier_value_rounded", F.round("tier_value", 0))
    .withColumn("tier_value_filled", F.coalesce("tier_value", F.lit(0)))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("currency_count_tier_value", F.count("tier_value").over(w))
    .withColumn("tier_value_filled_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("tier_value_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w3))
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .withColumn("currency_count_tier_value_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w4))
    .withColumn("currency_avg_tier_value_cume_dist", F.avg("tier_value_cume_dist").over(w))
    .withColumn("tier_value_rounded_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_grp))
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("currency_avg_tier_value_cume_dist_tier", F.when(F.col("currency_avg_tier_value_cume_dist") >= 1, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .cube("currency_avg_tier_value_cume_dist_tier")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("tier_value_rounded_percent_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("tier_value_rounded_percent_rank_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.sum("currency_count_tier_value") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("currency") == "EUR", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("currency_count_tier_value_per_eur"),
        F.max("tier_value_filled_rank").alias("max_tier_value_filled_rank"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("currency")).alias("num_currencies"),
        F.avg("currency_count_tier_value").alias("avg_currency_count_tier_value"),
        F.percentile_approx("currency_count_tier_value_cume_dist", 0.95).alias("currency_count_tier_value_cume_dist_p95"),
        F.grouping("currency_avg_tier_value_cume_dist_tier").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("max_tier_value_filled_rank") >= 0)
)

    SELECT s.*
    FROM orders s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id

FROM not_flagged

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_FORMAT(delivered_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') delivered_date_label,
        CAST(cost AS INT) cost_int
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date >= DATE '2023-11-21'
      AND carrier IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier, order_id ORDER BY shipped_date DESC) = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(cost, 2) cost_rounded,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') carrier_filled
    FROM deduped
    WHERE shipped_date > DATE '2023-04-03'
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost_int, id) AS row_num
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT s.*, d.order_date
    FROM latest s
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON s.order_id = d.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    delivered_date,
    cost,
    cost_int,
    cost_rounded,
    carrier_filled
FROM joined
ORDER BY id, cost_rounded DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost_int", "id")

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.lit("2023-11-21").cast("date")) & F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("delivered_date_label", F.date_format("delivered_date", "yyyy-MM-dd"))
    .withColumn("cost_int", F.col("cost").cast("int"))
)

deduped = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

cleaned = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-04-03").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("cost", 2).alias("cost_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("NONE")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

joined = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("d.order_date"))
)

result = (
    joined
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "cost_int",
        "cost_rounded",
        "carrier_filled",
    )
    .orderBy("id", F.col("cost_rounded").desc())
)

sql:
with scored as (
    select
        *,
        avg(rating) over (partition by country order by rating, id rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding) as rating_avg_2_prior,
        stddev_samp(rating) over (partition by country) as country_stddev_samp_rating,
        sum(rating) over (partition by city order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_rating,
        round(rating / sum(rating) over (partition by country), 4) as rating_share,
        last_value(city) ignore nulls over (partition by country order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_city
    from suppliers
)
select
    country,
    case when country_stddev_samp_rating >= 4 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as country_stddev_samp_rating_tier,
    count(distinct country) as distinct_countries,
    round(sum(rating_avg_2_prior) / nullif(count(case when city = 'Singapore' then 1 end), 0), 2) as rating_avg_2_prior_per_singapore,
    round(sum(rating_avg_2_prior) / nullif(count(case when country = 'TH' then 1 end), 0), 2) as rating_avg_2_prior_per_th,
    sum(rating_avg_2_prior) filter (where city = 'Berlin') as berlin_total_rating_avg_2_prior,
    round(avg(cumulative_rating), 2) as avg_cumulative_rating
from scored
group by rollup (country, case when country_stddev_samp_rating >= 4 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end)
having round(avg(cumulative_rating), 2) > 0
order by rating_avg_2_prior_per_th desc nulls last;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

scored = (
    df_suppliers
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("rating").over(w).alias("rating_avg_2_prior"),
        F.stddev_samp("rating").over(w2).alias("country_stddev_samp_rating"),
        F.sum("rating").over(w3).alias("cumulative_rating"),
        F.round((F.col("rating") / F.sum("rating").over(w2)), 4).alias("rating_share"),
        F.last("city", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("last_known_city"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .rollup(
        "country",
        F.when(F.col("country_stddev_samp_rating") >= 4, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("country_stddev_samp_rating_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("country").alias("distinct_countries"),
        F.round(F.sum("rating_avg_2_prior") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Singapore", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("rating_avg_2_prior_per_singapore"),
        F.round(F.sum("rating_avg_2_prior") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("country") == "TH", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("rating_avg_2_prior_per_th"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Berlin", F.col("rating_avg_2_prior"))).alias("berlin_total_rating_avg_2_prior"),
        F.round(F.avg("cumulative_rating"), 2).alias("avg_cumulative_rating"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_cumulative_rating") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("rating_avg_2_prior_per_th").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        HOUR(event_time) AS event_time_hour,
        COALESCE(page, 'NONE') AS page_filled
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time > DATE '2023-10-25'
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM filtered
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id_2
    FROM gaps
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    event_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) AS total_duration_sec,
    AVG(session_id_2) FILTER (WHERE page = '/checkout') AS checkout_avg_session_id_2
FROM islands
GROUP BY 1
HAVING SUM(duration_sec) >= 0
ORDER BY total_duration_sec NULLS FIRST

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, YEAR(starts_on) starts_on_year
    FROM promotions
    WHERE MONTH(starts_on) IN (5, 6, 11)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY starts_on_year NULLS FIRST) starts_on_year_dense_rank,
        SUM(starts_on_year) OVER w_grp running_starts_on_year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on, id) seq_no
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY starts_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY starts_on, id) = 1

WITH with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        d.amount,
        d.channel,
        d.discount
    FROM shipments e
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON e.order_id = d.id
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT status
    FROM with_dims
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT status
    FROM shipments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.status = k.status
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY discount NULLS LAST) AS discount_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount NULLS FIRST) AS discount_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status, channel ORDER BY cost) AS cost_rank
    FROM verified
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN discount >= 0.31 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS discount_tier,
    carrier,
    ROUND(AVG(cost), 2) AS avg_cost,
    ROUND(AVG(cost), 2) AS avg_cost_2,
    ROUND(SUM(cost) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS cost_per_mobile,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN discount_rank ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_discount_rank,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'IN_TRANSIT') AS in_transit_events
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN discount >= 0.31 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, carrier
ORDER BY avg_cost DESC

    FROM with_windows

    FROM prev_events

sessions_promotions AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY promotion_promo_code ORDER BY starts_on_period ASC, id ASC, promo_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps

    .filter(F.col("starts_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-29")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_trunc("week", "starts_on").alias("starts_on_period"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_channel"),
    )
)

attributed = (
    filtered
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("e.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("e.starts_on_period") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("e.starts_on_period") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    attributed
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("promo_id", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("first_known_promo_id"),
        F.last("promotion_discount_pct", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

prev_events = with_windows.withColumn("prev_starts_on_period", F.lag("starts_on_period").over(w3))

with_gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_starts_on_period").isNull() | (F.col("starts_on_period") > F.col("prev_starts_on_period") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_promotions = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w4))

attributed_promotions = (
    sessions_promotions
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("a.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("a.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("a.ends_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_2"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code_2"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_2"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    attributed_promotions
    .withColumn("discount_pct_avg_3", F.avg("discount_pct").over(w5))
    .withColumn("prev_promotion_discount_pct_2", F.lag("promotion_discount_pct_2", 1).over(w6))
)

with_window = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("src.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & F.col("src.starts_on_period").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_3"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code_3"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_3"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_window
    .groupBy("promotion_promo_code_2")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("discount_pct_avg_3", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("discount_pct_avg_3_quartiles"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", 1)).alias("mobile_count"),
        F.min("promotion_discount_pct").alias("min_promotion_discount_pct"),
    )

WITH with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name ORDER BY budget ASC, id ASC) AS budget_bucket,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget ASC) AS budget_cume_dist
    FROM departments
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN budget_bucket >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS budget_bucket_tier,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'HR' THEN 1 END) AS hr_count,
    COUNT_IF(dept_name = 'Engineering') AS engineering_events,
    STDDEV_SAMP(budget) AS budget_stddev,
    SUM(CASE WHEN location = 'Bangkok' THEN budget ELSE 0 END) AS bangkok_budget,
    MAX(budget_cume_dist) FILTER (WHERE location = 'Singapore') AS singapore_max_budget_cume_dist,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dept_name) AS distinct_dept_names
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY engineering_events ASC NULLS FIRST;

            SELECT c.unit_price AS order_item_unit_price, c.quantity
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.unit_price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1

with_windows AS (

        category,
        brand,
        price,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        product_name_lower,
        city,
        supplier_name,
        order_item_unit_price,
        quantity,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY quantity, id) AS quantity_bucket,
        AVG(cost) OVER w_part AS cost_avg_5
    FROM with_latest
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY supplier_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    brand,
    MAX(cost_avg_5) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Home') AS home_max_cost_avg_5,
    ROUND(SUM(stock_qty) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN brand = 'Initech' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS stock_qty_per_initech,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(brand)) AS num_brands
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY brand
HAVING MAX(cost_avg_5) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Home') >= 0;

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        CASE WHEN quantity >= 267 THEN 'High' WHEN quantity >= 54 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS quantity_tier
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2023-08-16'
      AND product_id IN (4, 8)
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM valid
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock BETWEEN '2023-12-01' AND '2024-10-01'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.id = k.id
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        ROUND(quantity * 0.85, 2) AS quantity_adjusted
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE quantity >= 116
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT s.*, p.product_name
    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN products p
        ON s.product_id = p.id
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        quantity_adjusted,
        INITCAP(TRIM(product_name)) AS product_name_title,
        quantity + quantity_adjusted AS quantity_plus_quantity_adjusted
    FROM enriched
    WHERE product_id IN (4, 5, 7, 9)
),
base_inventory AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, quantity / NULLIF(quantity_adjusted, 0) AS quantity_per_quantity_adjusted
    FROM filtered
    WHERE quantity_adjusted >= 73
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.store_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.product_name_title,
    (SELECT AVG(x.quantity) FROM inventory x WHERE x.product_id = s.product_id) AS avg_inventory_quantity
FROM base_inventory s
ORDER BY id NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

quantity_by_product_id = df_inventory.groupBy("product_id").agg(F.avg("quantity").alias("avg_inventory_quantity"))

valid = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-08-16").cast("date")) & F.col("product_id").isin([4, 8]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 267, "High").when(F.col("quantity") >= 54, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("quantity_tier"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    valid
    .select("product_id", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("last_restock").between("2023-12-01", "2024-10-01"))
        .select("product_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("quantity") >= 116)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        F.round((F.col("quantity") * 0.85), 2).alias("quantity_adjusted"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p.product_name"))
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([4, 5, 7, 9]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "quantity_adjusted",
        F.initcap(F.trim("product_name")).alias("product_name_title"),
        (F.col("quantity") + F.col("quantity_adjusted")).alias("quantity_plus_quantity_adjusted"),
    )
)

base_inventory = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("quantity_adjusted") >= 73)
    .withColumn("quantity_per_quantity_adjusted", (F.col("quantity") / F.nullif("quantity_adjusted", F.lit(0))))
)

result = (
    base_inventory
    .join(quantity_by_product_id, on="product_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "product_name_title",
        F.col("avg_inventory_quantity"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        units,
        revenue,
        units * revenue AS revenue_per_unit
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-04-16'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY revenue_per_unit DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rn
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        p.launch_date,
        p.stock_qty
    FROM deduped src
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON src.product_id = p.id
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY stock_qty DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM with_dims
    ) x
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        units,
        revenue,
        revenue_per_unit,
        stock_qty,
        latest_rank,
        units / NULLIF(revenue_per_unit, 0) AS units_per_revenue_per_unit,
        DAYOFWEEK(launch_date) AS launch_date_dayofweek
    FROM latest
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_part AS revenue_percent_rank,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_ordered AS launch_date_dayofweek_bucket
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue NULLS FIRST), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY launch_date_dayofweek DESC, id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT src.*, p.cost
    FROM with_windows src
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON src.product_id = p.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    product_id,
    CASE WHEN revenue_percent_rank >= 0.61 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS revenue_percent_rank_tier,
    CASE WHEN units_per_revenue_per_unit >= 73 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS units_per_revenue_per_unit_tier,
    SUM(units) AS total_units,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(launch_date_dayofweek_bucket, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS launch_date_dayofweek_bucket_quartiles,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_id
FROM enriched
GROUP BY CUBE (product_id, CASE WHEN revenue_percent_rank >= 0.61 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN units_per_revenue_per_unit >= 73 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END)
ORDER BY product_id DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue_per_unit").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("stock_qty").desc(), "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue").asc_nulls_first())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("launch_date_dayofweek").desc(), "id")

cleaned = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") >= F.lit("2023-04-16").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "units",
        "revenue",
        (F.col("units") * F.col("revenue")).alias("revenue_per_unit"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

with_dims = (
    deduped
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("src.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.launch_date"), F.col("p.stock_qty"))
)

latest = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

valid = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "units",
        "revenue",
        "revenue_per_unit",
        "stock_qty",
        "latest_rank",
        (F.col("units") / F.nullif("revenue_per_unit", F.lit(0))).alias("units_per_revenue_per_unit"),
        F.dayofweek("launch_date").alias("launch_date_dayofweek"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .withColumn("revenue_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_part))
    .withColumn("launch_date_dayofweek_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w_ordered))
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("src.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.cost"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("revenue_percent_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("revenue_percent_rank") >= 0.61, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("units_per_revenue_per_unit_tier", F.when(F.col("units_per_revenue_per_unit") >= 73, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .cube("product_id", "revenue_percent_rank_tier", "units_per_revenue_per_unit_tier")
    .agg(
        F.sum("units").alias("total_units"),
        F.percentile_approx("launch_date_dayofweek_bucket", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("launch_date_dayofweek_bucket_quartiles"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),
    )

        is_vip_dense_rank,

        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY is_vip_dense_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS is_vip_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        ROUND(credit_limit / SUM(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id), 4) AS credit_limit_share
    FROM with_windows
)
SELECT

    s.element_filled,
    s.credit_limit_rank,
    s.is_vip_dense_rank,
    s.is_vip_dense_rank_2,
    s.is_vip_dense_rank_percent_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(t2.balance) FROM accounts t2 WHERE t2.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS avg_account_balance
FROM with_windows_carts s

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM promotions
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, id ASC) = 1
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM ranked src
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON COALESCE(src.channel, 'web') = pr.channel
       AND src.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND src.ends_on < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promotion_promo_code ORDER BY ends_on ASC) AS rn
    FROM matched
    QUALIFY rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        channel,
        promo_code,
        discount_pct
    FROM deduped
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(discount_pct) AS total,
    COUNT(1) AS item_count
    FOR promo_code IN ('SPRING10', 'BUNDLE')
)
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promotion_promo_code").orderBy("ends_on")

ranked = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

matched = (
    ranked
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.coalesce(F.col("src.channel"), F.lit("web")) == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("src.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("src.ends_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    matched
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy("channel")
    .pivot("promo_code", ["SPRING10", "BUNDLE"])
    .agg(F.max("discount_pct").alias("total"), F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("item_count"))
)

sql: with valid as (select *, case when txn_type = 'DEBIT' then 1 else 0 end is_debit, coalesce(merchant, 'N/A') resolved_merchant from transactions where txn_time > timestamp '2023-06-29 22:00:00' and is_flagged), gaps as (select *, case when lag(txn_time) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time, id) is null or txn_time > lag(txn_time) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time, id) + interval '14' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst from valid), sessions_transactions as (select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id from gaps) select island_id, date_trunc('year', txn_time) as year_start, max(txn_time) as last_seen, size(collect_set(merchant)) as num_merchants, min(txn_time) as first_seen from sessions_transactions group by island_id, date_trunc('year', txn_time) order by year_start desc nulls first
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_transactions
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") > F.lit("2023-06-29 22:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("is_flagged"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "DEBIT", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_debit"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_merchant"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    valid
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_transactions
    .groupBy("island_id", F.date_trunc("year", "txn_time").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.max("txn_time").alias("last_seen"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("merchant")).alias("num_merchants"),
        F.min("txn_time").alias("first_seen"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("year_start").desc_nulls_first())
)

        product_id,

    from inventory

from (

WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(discounts) t AS tier_value
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_min_tier_value,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_percent_rank
    FROM flattened
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        currency_min_tier_value,
        tier_value_percent_rank,
        currency_min_tier_value * tier_value AS currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value,
        tier_value_percent_rank / NULLIF(tier_value, 0) AS tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value
    FROM enriched
    WHERE tier_value_percent_rank BETWEEN 0.23 AND 0.77
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT currency, id
    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT
    SELECT currency, id
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE currency NOT IN ('EUR', 'THB')
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.currency = k.currency AND s.id = k.id
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM verified
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE effective_from >= '2024-04-01'
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM verified s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value) OVER w_recent AS plan_avg_tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value,
        AVG(tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value) OVER w_recent AS plan_avg_tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value_2,
        SUM(currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_sum_currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value
    FROM kept_rows
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY plan)
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN currency_sum_currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value >= 402 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS currency_sum_currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value_tier,
    plan,
    ROUND(AVG(tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value), 2) AS avg_tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'basic' THEN currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value ELSE 0 END) AS basic_currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value,
    MIN(tier_value_percent_rank) AS min_tier_value_percent_rank,
    SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'starter' THEN plan_avg_tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value ELSE 0 END) AS starter_plan_avg_tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN currency_sum_currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value >= 402 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'starter' THEN plan_avg_tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS starter_plan_avg_tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value_rank
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY currency_sum_currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value_tier, plan
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) > 1

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_last())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency_sum_currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value_tier").orderBy(F.col("starter_plan_avg_tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value").desc())

flattened = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode_outer("discounts").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("tier_value").over(w).alias("currency_min_tier_value"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("tier_value_percent_rank"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_percent_rank").between(0.23, 0.77))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "currency_min_tier_value",
        "tier_value_percent_rank",
        (F.col("currency_min_tier_value") * F.col("tier_value")).alias("currency_min_tier_value_times_tier_value"),
        (F.col("tier_value_percent_rank") / F.nullif("tier_value", F.lit(0))).alias("tier_value_percent_rank_per_tier_value"),

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        price + stock_qty price_plus_stock_qty,
        CASE WHEN stock_qty >= 365 THEN 'High' WHEN stock_qty >= 134 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END stock_qty_level,
        COALESCE(brand, 'NONE') brand_clean
    FROM products
    WHERE brand IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        brand_clean,
        price * price_plus_stock_qty price_times_price_plus_stock_qty
    FROM valid
    WHERE launch_date > DATE '2024-03-12'
      AND supplier_id IN (10, 14, 16)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(price) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, category ORDER BY stock_qty, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) price_avg_2_prior,
        FIRST_VALUE(price, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY stock_qty, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_price,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY stock_qty DESC) stock_qty_cume_dist
    FROM base
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales ch
            WHERE ch.product_id = s.id
              AND ch.sale_date <= s.launch_date
        )
),
with_windows_products AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        brand_clean,
        price_times_price_plus_stock_qty,
        price_avg_2_prior,
        first_known_price,
        stock_qty_cume_dist,
        SUM(price) OVER (PARTITION BY category, supplier_id ORDER BY price_avg_2_prior, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_price,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY price_times_price_plus_stock_qty DESC) price_times_price_plus_stock_qty_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(price_avg_2_prior) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_price_avg_2_prior
    FROM kept
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_ordered price_avg_2_prior_rank,
        AVG(first_known_price) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, brand ORDER BY cumulative_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) first_known_price_avg_3_prior,
        ROUND(first_known_price / SUM(first_known_price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand), 4) first_known_price_share,
        ROUND(first_known_price / SUM(first_known_price) OVER (PARTITION BY category, brand), 4) first_known_price_share_2
    FROM with_windows_products
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price_avg_2_prior NULLS FIRST)
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.product_name,
    s.category,
    s.launch_date,
    s.tags,
    s.supplier_id,
    s.brand_clean,
    s.price_times_price_plus_stock_qty,
    s.price_avg_2_prior,
    (SELECT SUM(p2.cost) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.supplier_id = s.supplier_id) AS sum_product_cost
FROM metrics s
ORDER BY id NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id", "category").orderBy("stock_qty", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)

w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("price_times_price_plus_stock_qty").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy(F.col("price_avg_2_prior").asc_nulls_first())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id", "brand").orderBy("cumulative_price", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("brand")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("category", "brand")
cost_by_supplier_id = df_products.groupBy("supplier_id").agg(F.sum("cost").alias("sum_product_cost"))

valid = (

    .filter(F.col("brand").isNotNull())

with_windows = (

    .withColumn("price_avg_2_prior", F.avg("price").over(w))

    .withColumn("first_known_price_share_2", F.round((F.col("first_known_price") / F.sum("first_known_price").over(w10)), 4))

result = (

WITH base AS (

        CASE WHEN account_type IN ('SAVINGS', 'CHECKING') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS account_type_group,
        COALESCE(status, 'N/A') AS status_clean
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (

    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY balance DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_in_group
        FROM base
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),

    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY opened_date NULLS FIRST, id) AS rn
        FROM latest
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
base_accounts AS (
    SELECT *, LEAST(rn, rank_in_group) AS least_rn_rank_in_group
    FROM latest_accounts
    WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2024-03-09'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            customer_id,
            status,
            account_type,
            least_rn_rank_in_group
        FROM base_accounts
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        AVG(least_rn_rank_in_group)
        FOR account_type IN ('CHECKING', 'LOAN')
    )
)
SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    s.status,
    s.CHECKING,
    (SELECT SUM(x.monthly_fee) FROM subscriptions x WHERE x.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS sum_subscription_monthly_fee

sql:
WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, TRIM(merchant) AS clean_merchant
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
      AND merchant IN ('Grab', '7-Eleven')
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_FORMAT(txn_time, 'yyyy-MM') AS txn_time_label,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) AS is_flagged_flag,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'UNKNOWN') AS merchant_filled
    FROM base
    WHERE is_flagged
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT txn_type, merchant
    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT txn_type, merchant
    FROM transactions
    WHERE amount < 3400
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.txn_type = k.txn_type AND s.merchant = k.merchant
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(is_flagged_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant) AS merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant), 4) AS amount_share,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id), 4) AS amount_share_2
    FROM reconciled
),
filtered_transactions AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        clean_merchant,
        is_flagged_flag,
        merchant_filled,
        merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag,
        amount_share,
        amount_share_2,
        CASE WHEN merchant IN ('Starbucks', 'Grab') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS merchant_group,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'NONE') AS merchant_filled_2
    FROM enriched
    WHERE amount_share_2 < 0.65
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(amount_share_2) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS account_id_stddev_samp_amount_share_2,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag NULLS LAST) AS merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag_cume_dist,
        AVG(merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag_avg_30d
    FROM filtered_transactions
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', txn_time) AS activity_month,
    CASE WHEN account_id_stddev_samp_amount_share_2 >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS account_id_stddev_samp_amount_share_2_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'REFUND' THEN merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag ELSE 0 END) AS refund_merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag,
    MAX(txn_time) AS last_seen,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(merchant)) AS num_merchants
FROM scored
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', txn_time), CASE WHEN account_id_stddev_samp_amount_share_2 >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY refund_merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("merchant")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_id")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & F.col("merchant").isin(["Grab", "7-Eleven"]))
    .select("*", F.trim("merchant").alias("clean_merchant"))
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_format("txn_time", "yyyy-MM").alias("txn_time_label"),
        F.col("is_flagged").cast("int").alias("is_flagged_flag"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("merchant_filled"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("txn_type", "merchant")
    .exceptAll(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.col("amount") < 3400)
        .select("txn_type", "merchant")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")) & (F.col("s.merchant") == F.col("k.merchant")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag", F.stddev_samp("is_flagged_flag").over(w))
    .withColumn("amount_share", F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(w)), 4))
    .withColumn("amount_share_2", F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(w2)), 4))
)

filtered_transactions = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("amount_share_2") < 0.65)
    .select(
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "clean_merchant",
        "is_flagged_flag",
        "merchant_filled",
        "merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag",
        "amount_share",
        "amount_share_2",
        F.when(F.col("merchant").isin(["Starbucks", "Grab"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other").alias("merchant_group"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("NONE")).alias("merchant_filled_2"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered_transactions
    .withColumn("account_id_stddev_samp_amount_share_2", F.stddev_samp("amount_share_2").over(w2))
    .withColumn("merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w3))
    .withColumn("merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag_avg_30d", F.avg("merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag").over(w4))
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "txn_time").alias("activity_month"),
        F.when(F.col("account_id_stddev_samp_amount_share_2") >= 1, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("account_id_stddev_samp_amount_share_2_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "REFUND", F.col("merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag")).otherwise(0)).alias("refund_merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag"),
        F.max("txn_time").alias("last_seen"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("merchant")).alias("num_merchants"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("refund_merchant_stddev_samp_is_flagged_flag").asc_nulls_last())
)
