WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, quantity - unit_price AS line_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IN (17, 33)
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        unit_price / NULLIF(line_total, 0) AS unit_price_per_line_total,
        CASE WHEN quantity >= 8 THEN 'High' WHEN quantity >= 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS quantity_level
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE quantity < 7
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(quantity, 1) OVER (ORDER BY line_total ASC, id ASC) AS next_quantity,
        CORR(unit_price, quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id) AS corr_unit_price_quantity,
        CORR(quantity, unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS corr_quantity_unit_price
    FROM valid
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY corr_unit_price_quantity DESC, id ASC) = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.channel,
        b.shipping_fee,
        b.status
    FROM ranked src
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON src.order_id = b.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        p.product_name,
        p.stock_qty
    FROM joined e
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON e.product_id = p.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    line_total,
    quantity_level,
    corr_unit_price_quantity,
    shipping_fee,
    status,
    product_name
FROM with_dims
ORDER BY corr_unit_price_quantity ASC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("line_total", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("corr_unit_price_quantity").desc(), "id")

cleaned = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([17, 33]))
    .select("*", (F.col("quantity") - F.col("unit_price")).alias("line_total"))
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("quantity") < 7)
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("unit_price") / F.nullif("line_total", F.lit(0))).alias("unit_price_per_line_total"),
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 8, "High").when(F.col("quantity") >= 2, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("quantity_level"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .withColumn("next_quantity", F.lead("quantity", 1).over(w))
    .withColumn("corr_unit_price_quantity", F.corr("unit_price", "quantity").over(w2))
    .withColumn("corr_quantity_unit_price", F.corr("quantity", "unit_price").over(w3))
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

joined = (
    ranked
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.channel"), F.col("b.shipping_fee"), F.col("b.status"))
)

with_dims = (
    joined
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.product_name"), F.col("p.stock_qty"))
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "line_total",
        "quantity_level",
        "corr_unit_price_quantity",
        "shipping_fee",
        "status",
        "product_name",
    )
    .orderBy("corr_unit_price_quantity")
)

WITH gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM transactions
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT txn_type, merchant
    FROM islands
    EXCEPT
    SELECT txn_type, merchant
    FROM transactions
    WHERE account_id IN (11, 13, 17, 22)
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.txn_type = k.txn_type AND s.merchant = k.merchant
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        is_flagged,
        new_group_flag,
        burst_id,
        INITCAP(TRIM(txn_type)) AS txn_type_title,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'DIRECT') AS merchant_clean
    FROM verified
    WHERE txn_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-12-30 13:00:00')
)
SELECT
    id,
    txn_time,
    new_group_flag,
    burst_id,
    txn_type_title
FROM filtered
ORDER BY new_group_flag DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

gaps = (
    df_transactions
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

matched_keys = (
    islands
    .select("txn_type", "merchant")
    .subtract(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.col("account_id").isin([11, 13, 17, 22]))
        .select("txn_type", "merchant")
    )
)

verified = (
    islands
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")) & (F.col("s.merchant") == F.col("k.merchant")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("txn_time") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-12-30 13:00:00")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "is_flagged",
        "new_group_flag",
        "burst_id",
        F.initcap(F.trim("txn_type")).alias("txn_type_title"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("merchant_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select("id", "txn_time", "new_group_flag", "burst_id", "txn_type_title")

with deduped as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by country, city order by credit_limit desc, id asc) as dedup_rank
        from customers
    ) ranked
    where dedup_rank = 1
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        last_value(age, true) over (partition by segment order by dedup_rank asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_age,
        avg(age) over (order by dedup_rank asc, id asc rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding) as age_avg_2_prior
    from deduped
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select id, country
    from scored
    intersect
    select id, country
    from customers
    where segment in ('Consumer', 'SMB')
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from scored s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.country = k.country
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        floor(credit_limit) as credit_limit_whole,
        credit_limit + age_avg_2_prior as credit_limit_plus_age_avg_2_prior
    from reconciled
    where signup_date >= date '2023-10-13'
      and city is not null
      and last_known_age > 51
)
select
    id,
    name,
    country,
    segment,
    signup_date,
    is_active,
    age,
    dedup_rank,
    last_known_age
from filtered
order by country asc, signup_date asc

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("dedup_rank", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)

deduped = (
    df_customers
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("last_known_age", F.last("age", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("age_avg_2_prior", F.avg("age").over(w3))
)

matched_keys = (
    scored
    .select("id", "country")
    .intersect(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("segment").isin(["Consumer", "SMB"]))
        .select("id", "country")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.country") == F.col("k.country")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    reconciled
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") >= F.lit("2023-10-13").cast("date")) & F.col("city").isNotNull() & (F.col("last_known_age") > 51))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.floor("credit_limit").alias("credit_limit_whole"),
        (F.col("credit_limit") + F.col("age_avg_2_prior")).alias("credit_limit_plus_age_avg_2_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "country",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "is_active",
        "age",
        "dedup_rank",
        "last_known_age",
    )
    .orderBy("country", "signup_date")
)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(balance * 0.9, 2) AS adjusted_balance,
        CASE WHEN status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_open
    FROM accounts
    WHERE balance BETWEEN 56000 AND 59000
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        adjusted_balance,
        is_open,
        SUM(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY adjusted_balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY is_open DESC) AS is_open_rank
    FROM base
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY balance, id) AS rn
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT status, customer_id
    FROM latest
    EXCEPT
    SELECT status, customer_id
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status IN ('CLOSED', 'OPEN', 'FROZEN')
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.status = k.status AND s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY is_open) AS is_open_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER w_hist AS running_balance_rank,
        COUNT(running_balance) OVER w_recent AS customer_id_count_running_balance,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY balance DESC NULLS FIRST) AS balance_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_ordered AS balance_dense_rank
    FROM kept_rows
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_balance DESC NULLS LAST), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY customer_id), w_ordered AS (ORDER BY balance NULLS LAST)
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    account_type,
    balance,
    opened_date,
    status,
    running_balance,
    is_open_rank,
    rn,
    running_balance_rank,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(CLOSED|FROZEN)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' WHEN status RLIKE '^(OPEN)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS status_zone
FROM enriched
ORDER BY is_open_rank DESC NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("adjusted_balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("is_open").desc())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("balance", "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("is_open")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("running_balance").desc_nulls_last())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("balance").desc_nulls_first())
w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("balance").asc_nulls_last())

base = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.col("balance").between(56000, 59000))
    .withColumn("adjusted_balance", F.round((F.col("balance") * 0.9), 2))
    .withColumn("is_open", F.when(F.col("status") == "OPEN", 1).otherwise(0))
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .withColumn("running_balance", F.sum("balance").over(w))
    .withColumn("is_open_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

kept_keys = (
    latest
    .select("status", "customer_id")
    .subtract(
        df_accounts
        .filter(F.col("status").isin(["CLOSED", "OPEN", "FROZEN"]))
        .select("status", "customer_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")) & (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    kept_rows
    .withColumn("is_open_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w4))
    .withColumn("running_balance_rank", F.rank().over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("customer_id_count_running_balance", F.count("running_balance").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("balance_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w7))
    .withColumn("balance_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w_ordered))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "customer_id",
        "account_type",
        "balance",
        "opened_date",
        "status",
        "running_balance",
        "is_open_rank",
        "rn",
        "running_balance_rank",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(CLOSED|FROZEN)$"), "GROUP_A").when(F.col("status").rlike("^(OPEN)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("PRIORITY").alias("status_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_open_rank").desc_nulls_first())
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter((F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01 06:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("humidity").isNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "status_bits",
        F.greatest("status_bits", "pressure").alias("greatest_status_bits_pressure"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("greatest_status_bits_pressure").between(57, 64))
    .select(
        "id",
        "humidity",
        "status_bits",
        "greatest_status_bits_pressure",
        (F.col("humidity") / F.nullif("greatest_status_bits_pressure", F.lit(0))).alias("humidity_per_greatest_status_bits_pressure"),
        F.greatest("status_bits", "humidity").alias("greatest_status_bits_humidity"),
    )
)

valid_device_readings = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("humidity_per_greatest_status_bits_pressure").isNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.floor("humidity").alias("humidity_whole"),
        (F.col("status_bits") + F.col("greatest_status_bits_humidity")).alias("status_bits_plus_greatest_status_bits_humidity"),
    )
)

    .filter(F.col("greatest_status_bits_humidity").between(66, 71))

        "status_bits_plus_greatest_status_bits_humidity",
        F.ceil("humidity_per_greatest_status_bits_pressure").alias("humidity_per_greatest_status_bits_pressure_whole"),
    )
)

        "status_bits_plus_greatest_status_bits_humidity",
        "humidity_per_greatest_status_bits_pressure_whole",

        (F.col("humidity_whole") - F.col("greatest_status_bits_humidity")).alias("humidity_whole_minus_greatest_status_bits_humidity"),
    )
)

        "humidity_whole",
        "status_bits_plus_greatest_status_bits_humidity",

)

    )
)

WITH with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT e.*, b.price
    FROM store_sales e
    INNER JOIN products b
        ON e.product_id = b.id
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        price,
        DATE_SUB(sale_date, 36) AS sale_date_minus_36d
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-05-23'
      AND YEAR(sale_date) = 2023
),
with_dims_store_sales AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT s.*, p.city
    FROM base s
    LEFT JOIN stores p
        ON s.store_id = p.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        price,
        sale_date_minus_36d,
        city,
        LAST_VALUE(price, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY units, id) AS event_seq,
        LEAD(units, 1) OVER w_ordered AS next_units,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY units DESC, id) AS units_bucket,
        LAST_VALUE(units) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sale_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_units
    FROM with_dims_store_sales
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY price, id)
),
enriched_store_sales AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        price,
        sale_date_minus_36d,
        city,
        last_known_price,
        event_seq,
        next_units,
        units_bucket,
        last_known_units,
        FIRST_VALUE(price) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY units, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_price,
        ROUND(last_known_units / SUM(last_known_units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id), 4) AS last_known_units_share,
        LEAD(next_units, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY sale_date, id) AS next_next_units
    FROM enriched
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', sale_date_minus_36d) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Berlin' THEN 1 END) AS berlin_count,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    COUNT_IF(city = 'Berlin') AS berlin_events,
    ROUND(SUM(last_known_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'New York' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS last_known_price_per_new_york,
    SUM(last_known_units_share) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Bangkok') AS bangkok_total_last_known_units_share
FROM enriched_store_sales
GROUP BY activity_month
ORDER BY bangkok_total_last_known_units_share NULLS LAST;

with flattened as (
    select
        id,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        v
    from app_logs
    lateral view explode(context) li as k, v
),
parsed as (
    select
        id,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        cast((status_code & 1) != 0 as int) as has_fault,
        shiftright(status_code, 2) as status_code_high
    from flattened
    where k != 'region'
),
ranked as (
    select *, rank() over (partition by k order by has_fault desc) as latest_rank
    from parsed
    qualify latest_rank = 1
)
select
    case when status_code >= 393 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as status_code_tier,
    bit_or(status_code) as status_code_bit_or,
    count(case when level = 'ERROR' then 1 end) as error_count,
    size(collect_set(level)) as num_levels,
    sum(case when level = 'INFO' then status_code else 0 end) as info_status_code
from ranked
group by case when status_code >= 393 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end
order by info_status_code;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("has_fault").desc())

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

parsed = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("k") != "region")
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "status_code",

        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("has_fault"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    parsed
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    ranked
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_code") >= 393, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("status_code_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.bit_or("status_code").alias("status_code_bit_or"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "ERROR", 1)).alias("error_count"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("level")).alias("num_levels"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("level") == "INFO", F.col("status_code")).otherwise(0)).alias("info_status_code"),

sql:
WITH gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL 1 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM device_readings
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(device_code) AS clean_device_code,
        TRIM(firmware) AS clean_firmware
    FROM islands
    WHERE reading_ts < '2024-11-01'
),
filtered_device_readings AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, humidity * session_no AS humidity_times_session_no
    FROM filtered
    WHERE reading_ts > DATE '2025-09-01'
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL '45' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag_2
    FROM filtered_device_readings
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag_2) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM sessionized
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity_times_session_no, id) = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY session_id DESC) AS session_id_dense_rank,
        SUM(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY session_start_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_status_bits,
        COUNT(session_start_flag_2) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_start_flag_2_count_30m
    FROM latest
),
daily AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts) AS activity_day,
        CASE WHEN humidity >= 63 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS humidity_tier,
        MAX(session_no) AS max_session_no,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(session_id, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS session_id_quartiles,
        MAX(reading_ts) AS ended_at
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts), CASE WHEN humidity >= 63 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
)
SELECT
    activity_day,
    humidity_tier,
    max_session_no,
    session_id_quartiles
FROM daily
ORDER BY max_session_no NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("humidity_times_session_no", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("session_id").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("session_start_flag", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)

gaps = (
    df_device_readings
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

filtered = (
    islands
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") < "2024-11-01")
    .withColumn("clean_device_code", F.trim("device_code"))
    .withColumn("clean_firmware", F.trim("firmware"))
)

filtered_device_readings = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("humidity_times_session_no", (F.col("humidity") * F.col("session_no")))
)

with_gaps = (
    filtered_device_readings
    .withColumn("session_start_flag_2", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("session_start_flag_2").over(w2))

latest = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .withColumn("session_id_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("cumulative_status_bits", F.sum("status_bits").over(w5))
    .withColumn("session_start_flag_2_count_30m", F.count("session_start_flag_2").over(w6))
)

daily = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("DAY", "reading_ts").alias("activity_day"),
        F.when(F.col("humidity") >= 63, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("humidity_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("session_no").alias("max_session_no"),
        F.percentile_approx("session_id", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("session_id_quartiles"),
        F.max("reading_ts").alias("ended_at"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select("activity_day", "humidity_tier", "max_session_no", "session_id_quartiles")
    .orderBy(F.col("max_session_no").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, COALESCE(temp_c, 0) AS temp_c_filled
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE firmware IN ('2.0.1', '1.1.0', '1.0.3')
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        temp_c_filled,
        LEAD(status_bits, 1) OVER (ORDER BY status_bits, id) AS next_status_bits,
        SUM(humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code) AS device_code_sum_humidity
    FROM valid
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS temp_c_avg_30m,
        FIRST_VALUE(temp_c) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_temp_c,
        SUM(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_status_bits
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    id,
    device_code,
    reading_ts,
    temp_c,
    humidity,
    pressure,
    status_bits,
    firmware,
    next_status_bits
FROM enriched
ORDER BY firmware DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("status_bits", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code")

    .select(

    FROM products

    FROM with_dims
    WHERE launch_date > DATE '2023-09-25'

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        cost,
        greatest_price_cost,
        price
    FROM filtered
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR kpi IN (cost AS COST_VAL, greatest_price_cost, price)

WITH metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel) AS promo_code_avg_discount_pct,
        SUM(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_discount_pct,
        ROUND(discount_pct / SUM(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code), 4) AS discount_pct_share,
        AVG(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY ends_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS discount_pct_avg_6_prior,
        ROUND(discount_pct / SUM(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel), 4) AS discount_pct_share_2
    FROM promotions
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        discount_pct,
        promo_code_avg_discount_pct,
        cumulative_discount_pct,
        discount_pct_avg_6_prior,
        discount_pct_share_2,
        COALESCE(discount_pct_share, 0) AS discount_pct_share_filled,
        COALESCE(channel, 'DIRECT') AS channel_clean
    FROM metrics
    WHERE ends_on >= DATE '2023-06-11'
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
      AND discount_pct_share_2 BETWEEN 0.42 AND 0.56
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(discount_pct, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY promo_code_avg_discount_pct, id) AS next_discount_pct,
        SUM(discount_pct_share_2) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_discount_pct_share_2
    FROM cleaned
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY promo_code_avg_discount_pct, id) AS row_num
        FROM enriched
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CEIL(cumulative_discount_pct_share_2) AS cumulative_discount_pct_share_2_whole,
        COALESCE(channel, 'NONE') AS channel_clean_2
    FROM ranked
    WHERE starts_on > DATE '2023-06-06'
)
SELECT
    id,
    channel,
    promo_code_avg_discount_pct,
    cumulative_discount_pct,
    discount_pct_avg_6_prior,
    discount_pct_share_2,
    discount_pct_share_filled,
    next_discount_pct,
    cumulative_discount_pct_share_2,
    CASE WHEN channel RLIKE '^(store|web)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN channel RLIKE '^(mobile|partner)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS channel_zone
FROM base
ORDER BY channel_zone DESC, cumulative_discount_pct_share_2;

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel")

        F.avg("discount_pct").over(w4).alias("discount_pct_avg_6_prior"),

with kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id
    from inventory
    except all
    select id
    from inventory
    where quantity <= 94
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from inventory s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.id = k.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    product_id,
    store_id,
    approx_percentile(quantity, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as quantity_quartiles,
    approx_percentile(quantity, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as quantity_quartiles_2,
    approx_percentile(quantity, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as quantity_quartiles_3
from kept_rows
group by product_id, store_id;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

kept_keys = (
    df_inventory
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_inventory

    )
)

    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")

)

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        CORR(unit_price, quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id) AS corr_unit_price_quantity,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS seq_no,
        LAST_VALUE(quantity) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_quantity
    FROM order_items
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY seq_no ASC NULLS FIRST) AS row_num
        FROM metrics
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        d.amount,
        d.status
    FROM latest src
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON src.order_id = d.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        d.launch_date,
        d.stock_qty
    FROM joined a
    INNER JOIN products d
        ON a.product_id = d.id
),
joined_order_items AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.status AS order_status,
        p.discount,
        p.order_date
    FROM with_dims a
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON a.order_id = p.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.category,
        b.launch_date AS product_launch_date,
        b.price
    FROM joined_order_items e
    LEFT JOIN products b
        ON e.product_id = b.id
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
SELECT
    *,
    FIRST_VALUE(running_quantity) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY order_status ORDER BY stock_qty ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_quantity,
    SUM(running_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_sum_running_quantity,
    SUM(corr_unit_price_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS category_sum_corr_unit_price_quantity
FROM enriched

with attributed as (
    select
        s.*,
        pr.id as promo_id,
        pr.promo_code as promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct as promotion_discount_pct
    from promotions s
    left join promotions pr
        on s.channel = pr.channel
       and s.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       and s.ends_on <= date_add(pr.ends_on, 7)
),
enriched as (
    select
        *,
        first_value(channel) ignore nulls over (partition by promotion_promo_code order by discount_pct, id, promo_id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_channel,
        round(promo_id / sum(promo_id) over (partition by channel), 4) as promo_id_share
    from attributed
),
filtered as (
    select
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        promo_id,
        promotion_promo_code,
        first_known_channel,
        weekofyear(starts_on) as starts_on_weekofyear,
        coalesce(channel, 'DIRECT') as channel_clean
    from enriched
    where channel is not null
),
base as (
    select
        id,
        channel,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        promo_id,
        promotion_promo_code,
        first_known_channel,
        channel_clean,
        date_sub(starts_on, 73) as starts_on_minus_73d
    from filtered
    where starts_on >= date '2023-08-28'
),
ranked as (
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by channel order by promo_id desc nulls first, id, promo_id) as dedup_rank
        from base
    ) t
    where dedup_rank = 1
),
metrics as (
    select
        *,
        lead(promo_id, 2) over (partition by channel order by promo_id, id, promo_id) as next_promo_id,
        first_value(promo_id, true) over (partition by promotion_promo_code order by ends_on, id, promo_id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_promo_id
    from ranked
),
daily as (
    select
        date_trunc('week', ends_on) as week_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', ends_on) as quarter_start,
        round(avg(discount_pct), 2) as avg_discount_pct,
        sum(discount_pct) as total_discount_pct,
        count(distinct id) as distinct_ids,
        percentile_approx(discount_pct, 0.95) as discount_pct_p95,

        percentile_approx(next_promo_id, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as next_promo_id_quartiles
    from metrics
    group by week_start, quarter_start
    having distinct_promotion_promo_codes > 1
)

    quarter_start,
    avg_discount_pct,
    total_discount_pct,
    distinct_ids,
    discount_pct_p95,
    distinct_promotion_promo_codes
from daily;

    df_inventory.alias("i")

s.first_known_country, s.seq_no, s.seq_no_2, s.seq_no_bucket, s.session_no, case when country rlike '^(US|SG)$' then 'EXTENDED' when country rlike '^(TH|JP)$' then 'GROUP_A' else 'PRIORITY' end as code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device", "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("seq_no", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
balance_by_customer_id = df_accounts.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.min("balance").alias("min_account_balance"))

enriched = (
    df_sessions
    .withColumn("first_known_country", F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(w))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("seq_no_2", F.row_number().over(w3))
)

eligible = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.page").isin(["/home", "/search", "/checkout"])), "left_anti")
)

metrics = (
    eligible
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("seq_no").over(w4).alias("seq_no_avg_3"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_recent).alias("seq_no_bucket"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w6).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w6) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w7))

filtered = (
    islands
    .filter((F.col("started_at") >= F.lit("2023-06-28 05:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("seq_no_avg_3") != 6))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("seq_no") >= 7, "High").when(F.col("seq_no") >= 4, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("seq_no_band"),
        F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("browser_filled"),
    )
)

joined = (
    filtered
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.age"), F.col("p.segment"))
)

filtered_sessions = (
    joined
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-09-03").cast("date")) & (F.col("session_no") == 5))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "country",
        "first_known_country",
        "seq_no",
        "seq_no_2",
        "seq_no_bucket",
        "new_group_flag",
        "session_no",
        "seq_no_band",
        "age",
        "segment",
        F.round((F.col("seq_no_avg_3") * 1.07), 2).alias("seq_no_avg_3_adjusted"),
        F.substring("device", 1, 4).alias("device_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_browser"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered_sessions
    .join(balance_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "country",
        "first_known_country",
        "seq_no",
        "seq_no_2",
        "seq_no_bucket",
        "session_no",
        F.when(F.col("country").rlike("^(US|SG)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("country").rlike("^(TH|JP)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("PRIORITY").alias("country_zone"),
        F.col("min_account_balance"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("device").desc())
)

SELECT
    event_type,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', event_time) AS year_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT page) AS distinct_pages,
    ROUND(AVG(duration_sec), 2) AS avg_duration_sec,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS distinct_session_ids,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM web_events
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((event_type, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', event_time)), (event_type), ())
ORDER BY event_type NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_web_events
    .withColumn("year_start", F.date_trunc("YEAR", "event_time"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["event_type", "year_start"], ["event_type"], []],
        "event_type",
        "year_start",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("page").alias("distinct_pages"),
        F.round(F.avg("duration_sec"), 2).alias("avg_duration_sec"),
        F.countDistinct("session_id").alias("distinct_session_ids"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("event_type").asc_nulls_last())
)

sql: WITH metrics_long AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, status, discount, amount FROM orders) src UNPIVOT (metric_value FOR measure IN (discount, amount))) SELECT measure, CASE WHEN metric_value >= 67 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS metric_value_tier, SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status, MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE measure = 'discount') AS discount_max_metric_value, SUM(CASE WHEN measure = 'discount' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS discount_metric_value, SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_total_metric_value FROM metrics_long GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((measure, CASE WHEN metric_value >= 67 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (measure)) ORDER BY metric_value_tier DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

metrics_long = (
    df_orders
    .select("id", "status", "discount", "amount")
    .unpivot(["id", "status"], ["discount", "amount"], "measure", "metric_value")
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

result = (
    metrics_long
    .withColumn("metric_value_tier", F.when(F.col("metric_value") >= 67, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["measure", "metric_value_tier"], ["measure"]],
        "measure",
        "metric_value_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("measure") == "discount", F.col("metric_value"))).alias("discount_max_metric_value"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("measure") == "discount", F.col("metric_value")).otherwise(0)).alias("discount_metric_value"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED", F.col("metric_value"))).alias("completed_total_metric_value"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("metric_value_tier").desc())
)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(tier_limits) t AS tier_value
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CAST(tier_value AS STRING) AS tier_value_num
    FROM exploded
    WHERE currency IN ('EUR', 'USD')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        currency,
        tier_value,
        tier_value_num,
        LOWER(currency) AS currency_lower,
        LOWER(currency) AS currency_lower_2
    FROM base
    WHERE effective_from > DATE '2024-08-08'
      AND effective_from >= '2023-08-01'
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        currency,
        tier_value,
        tier_value_num,
        currency_lower,
        currency_lower_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value ASC) AS tier_value_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_dense_rank_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value ASC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_rank
    FROM scored
),
scored_price_tiers AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(tier_value) OVER w_running AS currency_max_tier_value,
        COUNT(tier_value_percent_rank) OVER w_running AS currency_count_tier_value_percent_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(tier_value_percent_rank) OVER w_running AS currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value_percent_rank ASC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_percent_rank_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value_dense_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_dense_rank_percent_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY currency)
),
totals AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        currency,
        CASE WHEN tier_value_rank >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS tier_value_rank_tier,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(currency)) AS num_currencies,
        ROUND(SUM(currency_max_tier_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS currency_max_tier_value_per_eur,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END) AS eur_count,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(currency_count_tier_value_percent_rank, 0.9) AS currency_count_tier_value_percent_rank_p90,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN 1 END) AS usd_count
    FROM scored_price_tiers
    GROUP BY currency, CASE WHEN tier_value_rank >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
    HAVING currency_count_tier_value_percent_rank_p90 < 0
)
SELECT
    currency,
    tier_value_rank_tier,
    num_currencies,
    eur_count,
    currency_count_tier_value_percent_rank_p90
FROM totals
ORDER BY currency ASC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("tier_value")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_first())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value_percent_rank").asc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value_dense_rank").desc_nulls_first())

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode_outer("tier_limits").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

base = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("currency").isin(["EUR", "USD"]))
    .select("*", F.col("tier_value").cast("string").alias("tier_value_num"))
)

cleaned = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("effective_from") > F.lit("2024-08-08").cast("date")) & (F.col("effective_from") >= "2023-08-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "currency",
        "tier_value",
        "tier_value_num",

    .filter(F.col("currency_count_tier_value_percent_rank_p90") < 0)

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(browser, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY device, country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_browser,
        FIRST_VALUE(country) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_country,
        FIRST_VALUE(country, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_country_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) AS event_seq
    FROM sessions
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        row_seq,
        last_known_browser,
        first_known_country,
        first_known_country_2,
        event_seq,
        INITCAP(TRIM(device)) AS device_title,
        HOUR(started_at) AS started_at_hour
    FROM enriched
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND event_seq > 5
),
enriched_sessions AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_ordered AS event_seq_dense_rank,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY event_seq, id) AS event_seq_bucket
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY event_seq DESC NULLS LAST)
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) + INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM enriched_sessions
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', started_at) AS activity_month,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(event_seq_bucket, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS event_seq_bucket_quartiles,
    MIN(event_seq) AS min_event_seq
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', started_at)
ORDER BY min_event_seq NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device", "country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

enriched = (
    df_sessions
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("last_known_browser", F.last("browser", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("first_known_country", F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
    .withColumn("first_known_country_2", F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(w4))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w5))
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("event_seq") > 5))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "row_seq",
        "last_known_browser",
        "first_known_country",
        "first_known_country_2",
        "event_seq",
        F.initcap(F.trim("device")).alias("device_title"),
        F.hour("started_at").alias("started_at_hour"),
    )
)

enriched_sessions = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("event_seq_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("event_seq_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w7))
)

gaps = (
    enriched_sessions
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w5).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w5) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w8))

result = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "started_at").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq_bucket", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("event_seq_bucket_quartiles"),
        F.min("event_seq").alias("min_event_seq"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("min_event_seq").asc_nulls_first())
)

    from web_events
),
islands as (
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by event_type order by event_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id_2
    from flagged

filtered as (

    where duration_sec between 194 and 222

        sum(first_known_duration_sec) over (order by duration_sec_adjusted_bucket, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_first_known_duration_sec,
        rank() over (order by duration_sec_adjusted_bucket desc nulls last) as duration_sec_adjusted_bucket_rank,
        sum(first_known_duration_sec) over (order by first_known_duration_sec, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_first_known_duration_sec_2
    from metrics

        dense_rank() over (order by duration_sec_adjusted_bucket_rank desc nulls last) as duration_sec_adjusted_bucket_rank_dense_rank
    from scored

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("duration_sec_adjusted", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("duration_sec_adjusted", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("first_known_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("duration_sec_adjusted_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_adjusted_bucket").desc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id")
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_first_known_duration_sec").desc(), "id")
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_adjusted_bucket_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w11 = Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.orderBy("running_first_known_duration_sec_2", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

flagged = (
    df_web_events
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("session_id_2", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

filtered = (
    islands
    .filter(F.col("event_time") > F.lit("2024-03-20").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "duration_sec",
        F.date_format("event_time", "yyyy-MM").alias("event_time_label"),
    )
)

filtered_web_events = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec").between(194, 222))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_band", F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 376, "High").when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 125, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_adjusted", F.round((F.col("duration_sec") * 100), 2))
)

metrics = (
    filtered_web_events
    .withColumn("first_known_duration_sec", F.first("duration_sec", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_adjusted_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w4))
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("cumulative_first_known_duration_sec", F.sum("first_known_duration_sec").over(w5))
    .withColumn("prev_seq_no", F.lag("seq_no", 1).over(w4))
    .withColumn("running_first_known_duration_sec", F.sum("first_known_duration_sec").over(w6))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_adjusted_bucket_rank", F.rank().over(w7))
    .withColumn("running_first_known_duration_sec_2", F.sum("first_known_duration_sec").over(w5))
)

scored_web_events = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(4).over(w8).alias("seq_no_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("row_seq"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w10).alias("duration_sec_adjusted_bucket_rank_dense_rank"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored_web_events
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("running_first_known_duration_sec_2").over(w11).alias("cumulative_running_first_known_duration_sec_2"),
        F.last("running_first_known_duration_sec_2", ignorenulls=True).over(w11).alias("last_known_running_first_known_duration_sec_2"),
        F.avg("seq_no_bucket").over(w12).alias("seq_no_bucket_avg_2"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("prev_seq_no") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("prev_seq_no_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("running_first_known_duration_sec_2") >= 2273, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("running_first_known_duration_sec_2_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.bit_and("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_bit_and"),
        F.min("running_first_known_duration_sec_2").alias("min_running_first_known_duration_sec_2"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no_bucket", 0.9).alias("seq_no_bucket_p90"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "prev_seq_no_tier",
        "running_first_known_duration_sec_2_tier",
        "duration_sec_bit_and",
        "distinct_ids",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_ids").desc(), "running_first_known_duration_sec_2_tier")
)

with with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by product_id order by sale_date desc, id) seq_no,
        avg(revenue) over (partition by product_id order by sale_date, id rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding) revenue_avg_2_prior
    from store_sales
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    select
        a.*,
        p.store_name,
        p.region,
        p.opened_date
    from with_windows a
    join stores p
        on a.store_id = p.id
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        round(revenue / sum(revenue) over (partition by region, product_id), 4) revenue_share,
        first_value(region) ignore nulls over (partition by store_id order by revenue, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) first_known_region
    from enriched
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
select *
from (
    select
        id,
        region,
        revenue_share,
        revenue
    from scored
) src
unpivot (
    reading for metric in (revenue_share, revenue as REVENUE)

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(location) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_location,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY budget NULLS LAST) AS budget_rank,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget DESC, id) AS budget_bucket
    FROM departments
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN budget_rank >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS budget_rank_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Sales' THEN 1 END) AS sales_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(budget_bucket, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS budget_bucket_quartiles,
    MIN(budget) AS min_budget,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count_2,
    MIN(budget_rank) AS min_budget_rank
FROM metrics
GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget_rank >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END

w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("budget").asc_nulls_last())

    .withColumn("last_known_location", F.last("location", ignorenulls=True).over(w))

        F.count(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "Sales", 1)).alias("sales_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("budget_bucket", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("budget_bucket_quartiles"),
        F.min("budget").alias("min_budget"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count_2"),
        F.min("budget_rank").alias("min_budget_rank"),

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) AS is_flagged_flag,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'UNKNOWN') AS merchant_filled
    FROM transactions
    WHERE txn_time > DATE '2024-05-12'
      AND merchant IS NOT NULL
      AND TO_DATE(txn_time) >= '2024-06-01'
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, txn_type ORDER BY amount ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC) = 1
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM latest
),
sessions_transactions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM gaps
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        merchant,
        txn_type,
        session_id
    FROM sessions_transactions
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(session_id) AS total,
    COUNT(1) AS item_count
    FOR txn_type IN ('REFUND' AS refund, 'FEE' AS fee)
);

    FROM ranked

    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.payment_status,
        x.payment_paid_at
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.status AS payment_status, c.paid_at AS payment_paid_at
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE

    s.customer_id,
    s.store_id,
    s.order_date,
    s.status,
    s.channel,

with lines as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        value
    from app_logs
    lateral view explode(context) li as attr_key, value
),
parsed as (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    select
        id,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        value,
        shiftright(status_code, 2) as status_code_high,
        cast((status_code & 1) != 0 as int) as is_flagged
    from lines
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        last_value(attr_key, true) over (partition by attr_key order by status_code asc, id asc, attr_key asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_attr_key,
        row_number() over (partition by attr_key order by status_code desc, id asc, attr_key asc) as seq_no
    from parsed
),
ranked as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from (
        select *, rank() over (partition by attr_key order by status_code_high desc) as dedup_rank
        from enriched
    ) t
    where dedup_rank = 1
),
enriched_app_logs as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        count(status_code_high) over (partition by attr_key) as attr_key_count_status_code_high,
        avg(seq_no) over (partition by attr_key order by status_code_high asc, id asc, attr_key asc rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) as seq_no_avg_5_prior,
        first_value(seq_no) ignore nulls over (partition by attr_key order by status_code asc, id asc, attr_key asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_seq_no,
        ntile(10) over (partition by attr_key order by status_code asc, id asc, attr_key asc) as status_code_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by attr_key order by dedup_rank asc, id asc, attr_key asc) as event_seq
    from ranked
)
-- Ranking and gap features
select
    *,
    sum(status_code_bucket) over (partition by attr_key order by status_code asc, id asc, attr_key asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_status_code_bucket,
    sum(status_code) over (partition by attr_key order by seq_no_avg_5_prior asc, id asc, attr_key asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_status_code,
    sum(seq_no_avg_5_prior) over (partition by attr_key order by seq_no asc, id asc, attr_key asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_seq_no_avg_5_prior
from enriched_app_logs

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id", "attr_key")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("seq_no_avg_5_prior", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("seq_no", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(

    )

from metrics

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS key, attr_value
),
flattened_attrs AS (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high,
        CAST((status_code & 1) != 0 AS INT) AS flag_bit1
    FROM flattened
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, COALESCE(key, 'unassigned') AS key_filled
    FROM flattened_attrs
    WHERE log_ts > TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-06-01 08:00:00')
      AND key = 'version'
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts, id, key) AS prev_log_ts
    FROM base
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_log_ts IS NULL OR log_ts > prev_log_ts + INTERVAL '45' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM prev_events
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
with_gaps_2 AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(prev_log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY prev_log_ts, id, key) IS NULL
                 OR prev_log_ts > LAG(prev_log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY prev_log_ts, id, key) + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM islands
),
sessions_app_logs AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY prev_log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps_2
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        status_code_high,
        flag_bit1,
        key_filled,
        prev_log_ts,
        is_new_burst,
        burst_id,
        is_new_session,
        session_no,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY flag_bit1 DESC, id, key) AS flag_bit1_bucket,
        RANK() OVER w_running AS burst_id_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_running AS burst_id_dense_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(status_code_high) OVER (PARTITION BY key) AS key_stddev_samp_status_code_high,
        LAG(burst_id, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY is_new_burst, id, key) AS prev_burst_id
    FROM sessions_app_logs
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY burst_id DESC)
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(prev_log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY prev_log_ts, id, key) AS prev_prev_log_ts
    FROM scored
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_prev_log_ts IS NULL OR prev_log_ts > prev_prev_log_ts + INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessions_app_logs_2 AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY prev_log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no_2
    FROM flagged
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    *,
    NTILE(3) OVER w_ordered AS flag_bit1_bucket_2,
    SUM(flag_bit1_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY key) AS key_sum_flag_bit1_bucket
FROM sessions_app_logs_2
WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY flag_bit1 DESC, id, key);

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        ROUND(sqft / SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city), 4) AS sqft_share,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sqft,
        LEAD(sqft, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft, id) AS next_sqft
    FROM stores
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
              AND c.last_restock < s.opened_date
        )
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        sqft_share,
        cumulative_sqft,
        next_sqft,
        LEAD(sqft_share, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft_share, id) AS next_sqft_share,
        SUM(next_sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_sum_next_sqft,
        LEAD(sqft_share, 1) OVER w_ordered AS next_sqft_share_2
    FROM not_flagged
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY sqft_share, id)
),
by_type AS (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            city,
            region,
            region_sum_next_sqft
        FROM metrics
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        SUM(region_sum_next_sqft) AS amount
        FOR region IN ('South', 'North', 'West')
    )
)
SELECT
    city,
    North,
    West
FROM by_type
ORDER BY North DESC;

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, level ORDER BY hire_date DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_salary
    FROM employees
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id ORDER BY running_salary DESC, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.budget,
        b.location,
        b.dept_name
    FROM latest e
    LEFT JOIN departments b
        ON e.dept_id = b.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        d.dept_name AS department_dept_name,
        d.location AS department_location
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN departments d
        ON src.dept_id = d.id
),
enriched_employees AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(salary) OVER w_ordered AS cumulative_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY salary, id) AS row_seq,
        AVG(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY latest_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS budget_avg_5_prior,
        SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_salary_2
    FROM with_dims
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY job_title, location ORDER BY running_salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
latest_employees AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched_employees
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, dept_name ORDER BY row_seq NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(budget AS INT) AS budget_int,
        seq_no * cumulative_salary AS seq_no_times_cumulative_salary
    FROM latest_employees
    WHERE full_name LIKE 'Al%'
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.full_name,
    s.email,
    s.manager_id,
    s.salary,
    s.hire_date,
    s.level,
    s.seq_no,
    s.latest_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.manager_id = s.manager_id) AS avg_employee_salary
FROM base s
ORDER BY avg_employee_salary NULLS FIRST;

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        shipping_fee,
        ROUND(amount, 1) AS amount_rounded,
        COALESCE(channel, 'N/A') AS resolved_channel
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-02-23'
      AND store_id IS NULL
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT src.*, d.sqft
    FROM valid src
    LEFT JOIN stores d
        ON src.store_id = d.id
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.paid_at < '2023-03-01'
        )
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        shipping_fee,
        amount_rounded,
        resolved_channel,
        sqft,
        FIRST_VALUE(shipping_fee) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_running AS first_known_shipping_fee,
        LAG(shipping_fee, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipping_fee, id) AS prev_shipping_fee,
        ROUND(sqft / SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, status), 4) AS sqft_share
    FROM not_flagged
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN amount >= 1530 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS amount_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(amount_rounded, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS amount_rounded_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    ROUND(SUM(sqft_share) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS sqft_share_per_mobile
FROM metrics
GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 1530 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY sqft_share_per_mobile;

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS('-', account_type, status) AS account_type_status_key,
        COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_status
    FROM accounts
    WHERE YEAR(opened_date) >= 2023
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        account_type_status_key,
        resolved_status,
        FIRST_VALUE(status) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY balance ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS seq_no,
        SUM(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_balance,
        AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY opened_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS balance_avg_2
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY balance DESC, id ASC)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT e.*, b.credit_limit
    FROM metrics e
    INNER JOIN customers b
        ON e.customer_id = b.id
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT status, id
    FROM with_dims
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT status, id
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status NOT IN ('OPEN', 'FROZEN', 'CLOSED')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.status = k.status AND s.id = k.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN balance >= 67000 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS balance_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date) AS activity_month,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(account_type)) AS num_account_types,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(cumulative_balance, 0.5) AS cumulative_balance_p50,
    ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS avg_balance,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(credit_limit, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS credit_limit_quartiles
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN balance >= 67000 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date)
ORDER BY balance_tier ASC NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("balance").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.year("opened_date") >= 2023)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws("-", "account_type", "status").alias("account_type_status_key"),
        F.coalesce("status", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("resolved_status"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .withColumn("first_known_status", F.first("status", ignorenulls=True).over(w))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("cumulative_balance", F.sum("balance").over(w3))
    .withColumn("balance_avg_2", F.avg("balance").over(w4))
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.credit_limit"))
)

    with_dims
    .select("status", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_accounts
        .filter(~F.col("status").isin(["OPEN", "FROZEN", "CLOSED"]))
        .select("status", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("balance") >= 67000, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("balance_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "opened_date").alias("activity_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("account_type")).alias("num_account_types"),
        F.percentile_approx("cumulative_balance", 0.5).alias("cumulative_balance_p50"),
        F.round(F.avg("balance"), 2).alias("avg_balance"),
        F.percentile_approx("credit_limit", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("credit_limit_quartiles"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("balance_tier").asc_nulls_last())
)
