WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(shipping_fee AS INT) AS shipping_fee_int,
        COALESCE(channel, 'OTHER') AS channel_clean
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date > TO_DATE('2023-10-13')
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching shipment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.shipment_cost
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.cost AS shipment_cost
            FROM shipments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.shipped_date <= s.order_date
            ORDER BY c.shipped_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT status
    FROM latest_match
    EXCEPT
    SELECT status
    FROM orders
    WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'SHIPPED', 'COMPLETED')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.status = k.status
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank,
        CORR(shipping_fee, amount) OVER w_recent AS corr_shipping_fee_amount
    FROM kept_rows
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY channel, status)
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.order_date,
    s.status,
    s.channel,
    s.amount,
    s.discount,
    s.shipping_fee_int,
    s.channel_clean,
    (SELECT MAX(x.balance) FROM accounts x WHERE x.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS max_account_balance
FROM metrics s
ORDER BY customer_id;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.shipped_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("channel", "status")
balance_by_customer_id = df_accounts.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.max("balance").alias("max_account_balance"))

cleaned = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("order_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-10-13")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("shipping_fee").cast("int").alias("shipping_fee_int"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("channel_clean"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.shipped_date") <= F.col("s.order_date")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.cost").alias("shipment_cost"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    latest_match
    .select("status")
    .subtract(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("status").isin(["PENDING", "SHIPPED", "COMPLETED"]))
        .select("status")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("amount_rank"),
        F.corr("shipping_fee", "amount").over(w_recent).alias("corr_shipping_fee_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .join(balance_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee_int",
        "channel_clean",
        F.col("max_account_balance"),
    )
    .orderBy("customer_id")
)

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT id, device_code, reading_ts, humidity, pressure, status_bits, firmware, CASE WHEN temp_c >= 38.7 THEN 'High' WHEN temp_c >= 19.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END temp_c_band FROM device_readings WHERE reading_ts > TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 12:00:00'), gaps AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL '30' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session FROM base), sessions_device_readings AS (SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id FROM gaps) SELECT device_code, DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts) AS hour_window, COUNT(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-03' THEN 1 END) AS dv_03_count, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS device_code_list, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS device_code_list_2 FROM sessions_device_readings GROUP BY device_code, hour_window ORDER BY device_code DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01 12:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        F.when(F.col("temp_c") >= 38.7, "High").when(F.col("temp_c") >= 19.1, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("temp_c_band"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_device_readings = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_device_readings
    .groupBy("device_code", F.date_trunc("HOUR", "reading_ts").alias("hour_window"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-03", 1)).alias("dv_03_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("device_code")).alias("device_code_list"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("device_code")).alias("device_code_list_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("device_code").desc())
)

WITH base AS (

        CASE WHEN browser = 'Safari' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_safari,
        CONCAT(browser, ' - ', device) AS browser_device
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at >= DATE '2023-10-19'
      AND browser IS NOT NULL
),
attributed AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM base a
    JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND a.started_at >= sub.start_date
       AND a.started_at < sub.end_date + INTERVAL 7 DAYS
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        started_at,
        is_safari,
        browser_device,
        subscription_id,
        plan,
        monthly_fee,
        ROUND(monthly_fee, 1) AS monthly_fee_rounded,
        COALESCE(plan, 'NONE') AS plan_clean
    FROM attributed
    WHERE started_at > TIMESTAMP '2023-11-04 09:00:00'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        started_at,
        is_safari,
        browser_device,
        subscription_id,
        plan,
        monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_rounded,
        plan_clean,
        AVG(monthly_fee_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS customer_id_avg_monthly_fee_rounded,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY subscription_id, id, subscription_id) AS subscription_id_bucket,
        SUM(is_safari) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY CAST(started_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS is_safari_sum_7d,
        AVG(subscription_id) OVER (ORDER BY monthly_fee, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS subscription_id_avg_3_prior,
        FIRST_VALUE(plan, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY is_safari, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_plan
    FROM valid
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        subscription_id,
        device,
        monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_rounded
    FROM enriched
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR measure IN (monthly_fee AS MONTHLY_FEE_VAL, monthly_fee_rounded)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("subscription_id", "id", "subscription_id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy(F.col("started_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("monthly_fee", "id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("is_safari", "id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") >= F.lit("2023-10-19").cast("date")) & F.col("browser").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("is_safari", F.when(F.col("browser") == "Safari", 1).otherwise(0))
    .withColumn("browser_device", F.concat("browser", F.lit(" - "), "device"))
)

attributed = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("a.started_at") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("a.started_at") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), "inner")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

valid = (
    attributed
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-11-04 09:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "started_at",
        "is_safari",
        "browser_device",
        "subscription_id",
        "plan",
        "monthly_fee",
        F.round("monthly_fee", 1).alias("monthly_fee_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("plan", F.lit("NONE")).alias("plan_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("monthly_fee_rounded").over(w).alias("customer_id_avg_monthly_fee_rounded"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w2).alias("subscription_id_bucket"),
        F.sum("is_safari").over(w3).alias("is_safari_sum_7d"),
        F.avg("subscription_id").over(w4).alias("subscription_id_avg_3_prior"),
        F.first("plan", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("first_known_plan"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "subscription_id",
        "device",
        F.col("monthly_fee").alias("MONTHLY_FEE_VAL"),
        "monthly_fee_rounded",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ["id", "subscription_id", "device"],
        ["MONTHLY_FEE_VAL", "monthly_fee_rounded"],

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, temp_c - humidity AS temp_c_minus_humidity
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 12:00:00'
      AND humidity > 70
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(temp_c_minus_humidity, 1) OVER (ORDER BY temp_c_minus_humidity, id) AS next_temp_c_minus_humidity,
        FIRST_VALUE(pressure) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY humidity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_pressure,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS seq_no,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c DESC NULLS LAST) AS temp_c_percent_rank,
        AVG(temp_c_minus_humidity) OVER w_part AS temp_c_minus_humidity_avg_2_prior
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity DESC, id), w_part AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) IS NULL
                 OR reading_ts > LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM enriched
),
sessions_device_readings AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT firmware
    FROM sessions_device_readings
    INTERSECT
    SELECT firmware
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE status_bits <> 11
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sessions_device_readings s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.firmware = k.firmware
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY burst_id DESC) AS burst_id_rank,
        SUM(temp_c_minus_humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS temp_c_minus_humidity_sum_1h
    FROM reconciled
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        temp_c_minus_humidity,
        next_temp_c_minus_humidity,
        first_known_pressure,
        seq_no,
        temp_c_percent_rank,
        temp_c_minus_humidity_avg_2_prior,
        new_group_flag,
        burst_id,
        burst_id_rank,
        temp_c_minus_humidity_sum_1h,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY burst_id_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS burst_id_rank_cume_dist,
        AVG(first_known_pressure) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_pressure_avg_1h,
        CORR(pressure, humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code) AS corr_pressure_humidity
    FROM scored
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(corr_pressure_humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS corr_pressure_humidity_avg_15m,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY first_known_pressure) AS first_known_pressure_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts) AS activity_day,
    CASE WHEN first_known_pressure_cume_dist >= 0.75 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS first_known_pressure_cume_dist_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(burst_id, 0.9) AS burst_id_p90,
    MIN(reading_ts) AS started_at,
    ROUND(AVG(burst_id_rank), 2) AS avg_burst_id_rank
FROM metrics
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts), CASE WHEN first_known_pressure_cume_dist >= 0.75 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY burst_id_p90 DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("temp_c_minus_humidity", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("humidity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("humidity").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc_nulls_last())
w_part = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("burst_id").desc())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("burst_id_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w11 = Window.orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w13 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w14 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("first_known_pressure")

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter((F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01 12:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("humidity") > 70))
    .withColumn("temp_c_minus_humidity", (F.col("temp_c") - F.col("humidity")))
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .withColumn("next_temp_c_minus_humidity", F.lead("temp_c_minus_humidity", 1).over(w))
    .withColumn("first_known_pressure", F.first("pressure", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("temp_c_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("temp_c_minus_humidity_avg_2_prior", F.avg("temp_c_minus_humidity").over(w_part))
)

gaps = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(w6).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(w6) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_device_readings = gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w7))

remaining_keys = (
    sessions_device_readings
    .select("firmware")
    .intersect(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("status_bits") != 11)
        .select("firmware")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    sessions_device_readings
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.firmware") == F.col("k.firmware")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("burst_id_rank", F.rank().over(w8))
    .withColumn("temp_c_minus_humidity_sum_1h", F.sum("temp_c_minus_humidity").over(w9))
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w10).alias("burst_id_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("first_known_pressure").over(w11).alias("first_known_pressure_avg_1h"),
        F.corr("pressure", "humidity").over(w12).alias("corr_pressure_humidity"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("corr_pressure_humidity").over(w13).alias("corr_pressure_humidity_avg_15m"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w14).alias("first_known_pressure_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("DAY", "reading_ts").alias("activity_day"),
        F.when(F.col("first_known_pressure_cume_dist") >= 0.75, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("first_known_pressure_cume_dist_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("burst_id", 0.9).alias("burst_id_p90"),
        F.min("reading_ts").alias("started_at"),
        F.round(F.avg("burst_id_rank"), 2).alias("avg_burst_id_rank"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("burst_id_p90").desc())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        pressure,
        TO_DATE(reading_ts) AS reading_ts_date
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE humidity BETWEEN 59 AND 70
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        pressure,
        reading_ts_date,
        ROUND(pressure / SUM(pressure) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code), 4) AS pressure_share,
        FIRST_VALUE(pressure) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_pressure,
        ROUND(temp_c / SUM(temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code), 4) AS temp_c_share,
        FIRST_VALUE(pressure, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY pressure, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_pressure_2
    FROM cleaned
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY pressure_share DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rn
        FROM metrics
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts) AS hour_window,
    ROUND(AVG(pressure_share), 2) AS avg_pressure_share,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS device_code_list,
    COUNT_IF(device_code = 'DV-01') AS dv_01_events
FROM deduped
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts)

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("pressure_share").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

cleaned = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("humidity").between(59, 70))

        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "pressure",
        F.to_date("reading_ts").alias("reading_ts_date"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("pressure") / F.sum("pressure").over(w)), 4).alias("pressure_share"),
        F.first("pressure", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_pressure"),
        F.round((F.col("temp_c") / F.sum("temp_c").over(w)), 4).alias("temp_c_share"),

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") > F.lit("2024-03-11").cast("date")) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws("/", "promo_code", "channel").alias("promo_code_channel_key"),
    )
)

matched = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("s.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & F.col("s.starts_on").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

attributed = (
    matched
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("a.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("a.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("a.ends_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_2"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code_2"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_2"),
    )
)

attributed_promotions = (
    attributed
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.coalesce(F.col("src.channel"), F.lit("web")) == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("src.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("src.ends_on") <= F.date_add(F.col("pr.ends_on"), 10)), "inner")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_3"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code_3"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_3"),
    )
)

result = (
    attributed_promotions
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("week", "starts_on").alias("week_start"),
        "promotion_promo_code_3",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("promotion_promo_code_3") == "VIP").alias("vip_events"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("promotion_promo_code_2") == "SPRING10", 1)).alias("spring10_rows"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("spring10_rows") < 1)
    .orderBy("spring10_rows")
)

with cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        ceil(discount_pct) as discount_pct_whole,
        case when promo_code in ('BUNDLE', 'WELCOME5') then 'Tier 1' else 'Other' end as promo_code_group,
        coalesce(channel, 'NONE') as resolved_channel
    from promotions
    where ends_on > date '2023-09-13'
      and starts_on < '2024-04-01'
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        discount_pct_whole,
        promo_code_group,
        resolved_channel,
        lead(discount_pct, 1) over (partition by channel order by discount_pct_whole asc, id asc) as next_discount_pct,
        min(discount_pct_whole) over (partition by promo_code) as promo_code_min_discount_pct_whole,
        count(discount_pct_whole) over (partition by promo_code) as promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole,
        avg(discount_pct) over (partition by promo_code, channel order by discount_pct asc, id asc rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) as discount_pct_avg_5_prior,
        avg(discount_pct_whole) over (partition by channel order by ends_on asc, id asc rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) as discount_pct_whole_avg_5_prior
    from cleaned
),
matched as (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    select
        src.*,
        pr.id as promo_id,
        pr.promo_code as promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct as promotion_discount_pct
    from enriched src
    left join promotions pr
        on src.channel <=> pr.channel
       and src.starts_on >= pr.starts_on
       and src.starts_on <= date_add(pr.ends_on, 3)
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select promo_code
    from matched
    intersect all
    select promo_code
    from promotions
    where promo_code = 'BUNDLE'
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from matched s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.promo_code = k.promo_code
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        rank() over (partition by promo_code order by promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole desc) as promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole_rank,
        round(promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole / sum(promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole) over (partition by channel, promo_code), 4) as promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole_share
    from reconciled
)
select
    id,
    channel,
    starts_on,
    ends_on,
    discount_pct,
    discount_pct_whole,
    resolved_channel,
    promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole,
    discount_pct_avg_5_prior,
    case when channel rlike '^(store|web)$' then 'GROUP_A' else 'OTHER_ZONE' end as channel_zone
from metrics
order by id desc, ends_on asc

    .alias("src")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("src.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("src.starts_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("src.starts_on") <= F.date_add(F.col("pr.ends_on"), 3)), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    matched
    .select("promo_code")
    .intersectAll(
        df_promotions
        .filter(F.col("promo_code") == "BUNDLE")
        .select("promo_code")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    matched
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.promo_code") == F.col("k.promo_code")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole") / F.sum("promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole").over(w6)), 4).alias("promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "discount_pct_whole",
        "resolved_channel",
        "promo_code_count_discount_pct_whole",
        "discount_pct_avg_5_prior",
        F.when(F.col("channel").rlike("^(store|web)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("channel_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc(), "ends_on")
)

),
enriched_products AS (

        s.*,

        d.city,

SELECT

FROM enriched_products

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, LEAST(amount, discount) AS least_amount_discount
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date > DATE '2024-02-10'
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_part AS shipping_fee_bucket,
        COUNT(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY status, customer_id) AS status_count_discount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS seq_no,
        CORR(shipping_fee, amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS corr_shipping_fee_amount,
        SUM(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS store_id_sum_shipping_fee
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY shipping_fee ASC, id ASC)
),
scored_orders AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount DESC, id ASC) AS amount_bucket,
        COUNT(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS store_id_count_shipping_fee
    FROM scored
),
scored_orders_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(corr_shipping_fee_amount) OVER (ORDER BY store_id_sum_shipping_fee ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_corr_shipping_fee_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY status_count_discount ASC, id ASC) AS row_seq
    FROM scored_orders
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        least_amount_discount,
        shipping_fee_bucket,
        status_count_discount,
        seq_no,
        corr_shipping_fee_amount,
        store_id_sum_shipping_fee,
        amount_bucket,
        store_id_count_shipping_fee,
        running_corr_shipping_fee_amount,
        row_seq,
        AVG(status_count_discount) OVER w_part AS status_count_discount_avg_2,
        SUM(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, status ORDER BY amount_bucket ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_discount
    FROM scored_orders_2
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY store_id_count_shipping_fee ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.shipped_date < s.order_date
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN running_corr_shipping_fee_amount >= 4 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS running_corr_shipping_fee_amount_tier,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 1 END) AS store_count,
    MAX(seq_no) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RETURNED') AS returned_max_seq_no,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS web_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN cumulative_discount ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_cumulative_discount
FROM kept
GROUP BY CASE WHEN running_corr_shipping_fee_amount >= 4 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY returned_max_seq_no ASC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status", "customer_id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy("store_id_sum_shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("status_count_discount", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("store_id_count_shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "status").orderBy("amount_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") > F.lit("2024-02-10").cast("date")) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.least("amount", "discount").alias("least_amount_discount"))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(4).over(w_part).alias("shipping_fee_bucket"),
        F.count("discount").over(w2).alias("status_count_discount"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("seq_no"),
        F.corr("shipping_fee", "amount").over(w3).alias("corr_shipping_fee_amount"),
        F.sum("shipping_fee").over(w4).alias("store_id_sum_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

scored_orders = (
    scored
    .withColumn("amount_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w5))
    .withColumn("store_id_count_shipping_fee", F.count("shipping_fee").over(w4))
)

scored_orders_2 = (
    scored_orders
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("corr_shipping_fee_amount").over(w6).alias("running_corr_shipping_fee_amount"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored_orders_2
    .withColumn("status_count_discount_avg_2", F.avg("status_count_discount").over(w8))
    .withColumn("cumulative_discount", F.sum("discount").over(w9))
)

kept = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.shipped_date") < F.col("s.order_date")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_corr_shipping_fee_amount") >= 4, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("running_corr_shipping_fee_amount_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "store", 1)).alias("store_count"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("status") == "RETURNED", F.col("seq_no"))).alias("returned_max_seq_no"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "web", 1)).alias("web_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", F.col("cumulative_discount")).otherwise(0)).alias("mobile_cumulative_discount"),
    )
    .orderBy("returned_max_seq_no")
)

sql:
with remaining_keys as (
    select status, store_id
    from orders
    intersect
    select status, store_id
    from orders
    where shipping_fee >= 18
),
verified as (
    select s.*
    from orders s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.status = k.status and s.store_id = k.store_id
)
select
    date_trunc('quarter', order_date) as quarter_start,
    customer_id,
    date_trunc('week', order_date) as week_start,
    stddev_samp(shipping_fee) as shipping_fee_stddev,
    stddev_samp(discount) as discount_stddev,
    sum(shipping_fee) as total_shipping_fee,
    dense_rank() over (partition by date_trunc('quarter', order_date) order by stddev_samp(shipping_fee) desc) as shipping_fee_stddev_dense_rank
from verified
group by 1, 2, 3
order by shipping_fee_stddev desc nulls last;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("quarter_start").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee_stddev").desc())

remaining_keys = (
    df_orders
    .select("status", "store_id")
    .intersect(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 18)
        .select("status", "store_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")) & (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("quarter", "order_date").alias("quarter_start"),
        "customer_id",
        F.date_trunc("week", "order_date").alias("week_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.stddev_samp("shipping_fee").alias("shipping_fee_stddev"),
        F.stddev_samp("discount").alias("discount_stddev"),
        F.sum("shipping_fee").alias("total_shipping_fee"),
    )
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_stddev_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w))
    .orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee_stddev").desc_nulls_last())
)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CEIL(salary) salary_whole,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'N/A') resolved_job_title
    FROM employees
    WHERE dept_id = 31
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY hire_date DESC, id) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        level,
        salary_whole,
        resolved_job_title,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC, id) salary_bucket,
        MAX(salary_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id, job_title) dept_id_max_salary_whole,
        SUM(salary_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary_whole, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_salary_whole,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary_whole NULLS LAST) salary_whole_cume_dist
    FROM deduped
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        level,
        salary_whole,
        resolved_job_title,
        salary_bucket,
        dept_id_max_salary_whole,
        running_salary_whole,
        salary_whole_cume_dist,
        AVG(dept_id_max_salary_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) dept_id_max_salary_whole_avg_6,
        AVG(running_salary_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY running_salary_whole, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) running_salary_whole_avg_2_prior
    FROM enriched
),
enriched_employees AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(dept_id_max_salary_whole_avg_6, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, job_title ORDER BY dept_id_max_salary_whole_avg_6, id) next_dept_id_max_salary_whole_avg_6,
        SUM(salary_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_salary_bucket,
        LAST_VALUE(salary_whole) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_running last_known_salary_whole,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY salary_whole, id) event_seq
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY job_title, dept_id ORDER BY salary_whole_cume_dist, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.level AS employee_level,
        b.full_name AS employee_full_name,
        b.hire_date AS employee_hire_date
    FROM enriched_employees e
    JOIN employees b
        ON e.manager_id = b.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    full_name,
    job_title,
    hire_date,
    level,
    salary_whole,
    resolved_job_title,
    salary_bucket,
    running_salary_whole,
    CASE WHEN job_title RLIKE '^(Designer|Analyst)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS job_title_zone
FROM with_dims
ORDER BY level DESC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy(F.col("hire_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("salary").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "job_title")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("salary_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy(F.col("salary_whole").asc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("running_salary_whole", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("manager_id", "job_title").orderBy("dept_id_max_salary_whole_avg_6", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "dept_id").orderBy("salary_whole_cume_dist", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.orderBy("salary_whole", "id")

base = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("dept_id") == 31)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ceil("salary").alias("salary_whole"),
        F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_job_title"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(3).over(w2).alias("salary_bucket"),
        F.max("salary_whole").over(w3).alias("dept_id_max_salary_whole"),
        F.sum("salary_whole").over(w4).alias("running_salary_whole"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("salary_whole_cume_dist"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("dept_id_max_salary_whole").over(w6).alias("dept_id_max_salary_whole_avg_6"),
        F.avg("running_salary_whole").over(w7).alias("running_salary_whole_avg_2_prior"),
    )
)

enriched_employees = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("next_dept_id_max_salary_whole_avg_6", F.lead("dept_id_max_salary_whole_avg_6", 2).over(w8))
    .withColumn("cumulative_salary_bucket", F.sum("salary_bucket").over(w9))
    .withColumn("last_known_salary_whole", F.last("salary_whole", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w11))
)

with_dims = (
    enriched_employees
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_employees.alias("b"), F.col("e.manager_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("b.level").alias("employee_level"),
        F.col("b.full_name").alias("employee_full_name"),
        F.col("b.hire_date").alias("employee_hire_date"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "job_title",
        "hire_date",
        "level",
        "salary_whole",
        "resolved_job_title",
        "salary_bucket",
        "running_salary_whole",
        F.when(F.col("job_title").rlike("^(Designer|Analyst)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("job_title_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("level").desc_nulls_last())
)

sql: WITH with_gaps AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) IS NULL OR reading_ts > LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) + INTERVAL 20 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session FROM device_readings), sessions_device_readings AS (SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id FROM with_gaps) SELECT island_id, device_code, COUNT(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-04' THEN 1 END) AS dv_04_count, MAX(is_new_session) FILTER (WHERE device_code = 'DV-02') AS dv_02_max_is_new_session, (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(reading_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(reading_ts))) / 60 AS duration_min, AVG(temp_c) FILTER (WHERE device_code = 'DV-03') AS dv_03_avg_temp_c, SUM(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-03' THEN pressure ELSE 0 END) AS dv_03_pressure FROM sessions_device_readings GROUP BY island_id, device_code ORDER BY dv_04_count NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_gaps = (
    df_device_readings
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_device_readings = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_device_readings
    .groupBy("island_id", "device_code")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-04", 1)).alias("dv_04_count"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-02", F.col("is_new_session"))).alias("dv_02_max_is_new_session"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("reading_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("reading_ts"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-03", F.col("temp_c"))).alias("dv_03_avg_temp_c"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-03", F.col("pressure")).otherwise(0)).alias("dv_03_pressure"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("dv_04_count").asc_nulls_last())
)

sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY last_restock DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM inventory
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        latest_rank,
        quantity + latest_rank AS quantity_plus_latest_rank
    FROM ranked
    WHERE store_id = 6
),
ranked_inventory AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM base
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity_plus_latest_rank DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, COALESCE(quantity, 0) AS quantity_filled
    FROM ranked_inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2023-03-22'
      AND product_id IN (3, 4, 5, 7)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity_plus_latest_rank DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank_2
        FROM valid
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank_2 = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(quantity_filled) OVER (ORDER BY quantity_filled, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS quantity_filled_avg_3,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY quantity, id) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY quantity_filled DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity NULLS LAST) AS quantity_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity_filled DESC NULLS FIRST) AS quantity_filled_rank
    FROM deduped
),
metrics_inventory AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY quantity_dense_rank DESC, id) AS quantity_dense_rank_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY latest_rank_2, id) AS seq_no_2,
        ROUND(seq_no / SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id), 4) AS seq_no_share,
        ROUND(quantity_filled_rank / SUM(quantity_filled_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id), 4) AS quantity_filled_rank_share
    FROM metrics
),
daily AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN quantity_plus_latest_rank >= 61 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS quantity_plus_latest_rank_tier,
        seq_no,
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', last_restock) AS quarter_start,
        ROUND(AVG(quantity_filled_avg_3), 2) AS avg_quantity_filled_avg_3,
        BIT_AND(quantity) AS quantity_bit_and,
        BIT_AND(quantity) AS quantity_bit_and_2
    FROM metrics_inventory
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN quantity_plus_latest_rank >= 61 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, seq_no, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', last_restock)), (CASE WHEN quantity_plus_latest_rank >= 61 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, seq_no))
)
SELECT
    quantity_plus_latest_rank_tier,
    seq_no,
    quarter_start,
    avg_quantity_filled_avg_3,
    quantity_bit_and,
    quantity_bit_and_2
FROM daily
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_plus_latest_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_plus_latest_rank").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("quantity_filled", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.orderBy("quantity", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_filled").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").asc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_filled").desc_nulls_first())
w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity_dense_rank").desc(), "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("latest_rank_2", "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("product_id")
w12 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id")

ranked = (
    df_inventory
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

base = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("store_id") == 6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        "latest_rank",
        (F.col("quantity") + F.col("latest_rank")).alias("quantity_plus_latest_rank"),
    )
)

ranked_inventory = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

valid = (
    ranked_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-03-22").cast("date")) & F.col("product_id").isin([3, 4, 5, 7]))
    .withColumn("quantity_filled", F.coalesce("quantity", F.lit(0)))
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("latest_rank_2", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank_2") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("quantity_filled").over(w4).alias("quantity_filled_avg_3"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("event_seq"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w7).alias("quantity_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w8).alias("quantity_filled_rank"),
    )
)

metrics_inventory = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(5).over(w9).alias("quantity_dense_rank_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w10).alias("seq_no_2"),
        F.round((F.col("seq_no") / F.sum("seq_no").over(w11)), 4).alias("seq_no_share"),
        F.round((F.col("quantity_filled_rank") / F.sum("quantity_filled_rank").over(w12)), 4).alias("quantity_filled_rank_share"),
    )
)

daily = (
    metrics_inventory
    .withColumn("quantity_plus_latest_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("quantity_plus_latest_rank") >= 61, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "last_restock"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["quantity_plus_latest_rank_tier", "seq_no", "quarter_start"], ["quantity_plus_latest_rank_tier", "seq_no"]],
        "quantity_plus_latest_rank_tier",
        "seq_no",
        "quarter_start",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("quantity_filled_avg_3"), 2).alias("avg_quantity_filled_avg_3"),
        F.bit_and("quantity").alias("quantity_bit_and"),
        F.bit_and("quantity").alias("quantity_bit_and_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "quantity_plus_latest_rank_tier",
        "seq_no",
        "quarter_start",
        "avg_quantity_filled_avg_3",
        "quantity_bit_and",
        "quantity_bit_and_2",
    )
)

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), ends_on) AS days_since_ends_on,
        COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS channel_filled
    FROM promotions
    WHERE discount_pct BETWEEN 0.15 AND 0.2
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), starts_on) AS days_since_starts_on,
        CASE WHEN channel IN ('partner', 'store') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS channel_group,
        COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS channel_filled_2
    FROM valid
    WHERE starts_on > TO_DATE('2023-08-17')
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on DESC, id ASC) AS rn
        FROM cleaned
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(days_since_ends_on) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY rn ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS days_since_ends_on_avg_6_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY ends_on DESC, id ASC) AS event_seq
    FROM latest
)
SELECT
    id,
    channel,
    promo_code,
    starts_on,
    discount_pct,
    days_since_ends_on,
    channel_filled,
    channel_group,
    channel_filled_2
FROM scored
ORDER BY discount_pct ASC NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("starts_on").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("rn", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("ends_on").desc(), "id")

valid = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("discount_pct").between(0.15, 0.2))
    .withColumn("days_since_ends_on", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "ends_on"))
    .withColumn("channel_filled", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter((F.col("starts_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-17"))) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "starts_on").alias("days_since_starts_on"),
        F.when(F.col("channel").isin(["partner", "store"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("channel_group"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("channel_filled_2"),
    )
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

scored = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("days_since_ends_on").over(w2).alias("days_since_ends_on_avg_6_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "days_since_ends_on",
        "channel_filled",
        "channel_group",
        "channel_filled_2",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").asc_nulls_first())
)

with filtered_employees as (
    select *
    from employees
    where not ((dept_id in (2, 35, 36) and dept_id = 34) or lower(email) like '%iam%')
),
job_title_summary as (
    select job_title, case when salary >= 120000 then 'high' when salary >= 60000 then 'mid' else 'low' end as salary_bucket, count(distinct salary) as unique_depts
    from filtered_employees
    group by job_title, case when salary >= 120000 then 'high' when salary >= 60000 then 'mid' else 'low' end
)
select *
from job_title_summary
order by unique_depts
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_employees = (
    df_employees
    .filter(~((F.col("dept_id").isin([2, 35, 36]) & (F.col("dept_id") == 34)) | F.lower("email").like("%iam%")))
)

job_title_summary = (
    filtered_employees
    .groupBy(
        "job_title",
        F.when(F.col("salary") >= 120000, "high").when(F.col("salary") >= 60000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("salary_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.countDistinct("salary").alias("unique_depts"))
)

result = job_title_summary.orderBy("unique_depts")
